name: Amlip 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLIP 5MG TABLET

AMLIP 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLIP 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLIP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLIP 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLIP 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLIP 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLIP 5MG TABLET Works

AMLIP 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLIP 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

How to use AMLIP 5MG TABLET
Take AMLIP 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.

sideEffects: Joint or muscle pain, back pain
Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing

Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AMLIP 5MG TABLET

Like all medicines, AMLIP 5MG TABLET may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of AMLIP 5MG TABLET:
Swelling of ankles
Headache, dizziness
Sleepiness, tiredness, muscle cramps
Palpitations (awareness of heart beat)
Flushing
Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, indigestion
Nausea
Altered bowel habits
Visual disturbances, double vision
Vomiting
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of AMLIP 5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMLIP 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLIP 5MG TABLET.
AMLIP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLIP 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLIP 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLIP 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLIP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

name: Cilniblu 5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET

CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET Works

CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageInstructions: Always take this medicine as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily.
Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.
Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

Side Effects Of CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET
Common Side Effects of CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET:
Swelling of the ankles or other body parts
Headache, dizziness, sleepiness
Palpitations (fast heartbeat)
Flushing (redness and warmth of the skin)
Stomach pain, nausea, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion
Changes in bowel habit
Tiredness, weakness
Increased urination at night
Gingival hyperplasia (enlargement of gums with inflammation)

warnings.details: CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Cilnidipine.

CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure or aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries). It should be used with caution in patients with angina or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.
CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Edema (swelling of body parts)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Anticancer agents (Ex. aldesleukin)
Antiepileptics (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin)
Antibiotics (Ex. erythromycin)
Anti-TB agents (Ex. rifampicin)
Anti-hypertensives and cardiac agents (Ex. quinidine, propranolol, digoxin)
Antipsychotics (Ex. risperidone, quetiapine, olanzapine)
Insulin (a medicine used for diabetes mellitus)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers) 

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more CILNIBLU 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:
Introduction About CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET

CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain and muscle tremors (shakiness).

CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney and heart disease. CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET Works

CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body which causes the narrowing of blood vessels).

Consult your doctor for advice.

Others

Decreased levels of potassium and sodium (hypokalaemia, hyponatraemia) and increased levels of calcium and urea (hypercalcaemia, hyperuricaemia)
Gout or uric acid calculi
Addison’s disease

Diabetes
Low blood pressure
Signs of high potassium in the body (muscle weakness or numbness in limbs, irregular or fast heartbeat)

CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

Interactions

Digoxin (a medicine used to manage heart failure and abnormal heart rhythm)
Cimetidine (a medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)

Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors used to manage high blood pressure (Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, ramipril)
Aliskiren (a medicine used to manage high blood pressure)
Medicines containing lithium (used to manage some types of depression)
Medicines that may increase blood potassium levels such as salt substitutes containing potassium, potassium-sparing diuretics (Ex. amiloride, spironolactone)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs - medicines used to manage pain and inflammation (Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen)
Heparin (a medicine used to manage blood clots)
Immunosuppressive agents such as ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)
Antibiotic trimethoprim (a medicine used to manage urinary tract infections)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage oedema or high blood pressure)
Corticosteroids such as dexamethasone, hydrocortisone which are involved in stress, immune response
Baclofen (a medicine used for muscle spasms)
Amifostine (a medicine used in cancer chemotherapy)
Barbiturates (medicine that acts as a central nervous system depressant) such as phenobarbital, pentobarbital

Narcotics such as morphine and codeine (a medicine used to manage moderate to severe pain)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET as it may increase the levels of this medication in the body.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of CILACAR TC 6.25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital as it may increase the risk of side effects. Signs and symptoms of overdosage include low blood pressure, dizziness, nausea, sleepiness, elevated creatinine levels, sudden kidney failure, electrolyte disturbances associated with cardiac arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) and muscle stiffness.

introduction:
Introduction About EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET

EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET contains Efonidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) which occurs when force exerted by the circulating blood against the blood vessel wall is high.

[GBNKEYOWRD] is also used to manage high blood pressure that occurs due to kidney diseases in affected individuals. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage angina (chest pain) that occurs when blood flow to the heart is low.   

EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Efonidipine.

Before taking EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart disease (such as heart attack, heart failure liver), kidney disease (such as renal impairment), and/or liver disease.  

EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breast-feeding women.

EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of taking EFNOCAR 40MG TABLET are hot flushes, palpitations, facial flushing, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET

AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:

High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET Works

AMLOVAS 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCIGARD 10MG CAPSULE

CALCIGARD 10MG CAPSULE contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

CALCIGARD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

CALCIGARD 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking CALCIGARD 10MG CAPSULE are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:

Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How CALCIGARD 10MG CAPSULE Works

CALCIGARD 10MG CAPSULE reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

introduction:
Introduction About CILEDGE 10MG TABLET

CILEDGE 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILEDGE 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILEDGE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILEDGE 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILEDGE 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILEDGE 10MG TABLET Works

CILEDGE 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

name: Amlodac 5mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLODAC 5MG TABLET

AMLODAC 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLODAC 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLODAC 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLODAC 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLODAC 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLODAC 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLODAC 5MG TABLET Works

AMLODAC 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLODAC 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

AMLODAC 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLODAC 5MG TABLET.
AMLODAC 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLODAC 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLODAC 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLODAC 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLODAC 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About DILZEM 30MG TABLET

DILZEM 30MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with DILZEM 30MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILZEM 30MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILZEM 30MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILZEM 30MG TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILZEM 30MG TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DILZEM 30MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How DILZEM 30MG TABLET Works

DILZEM 30MG TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use DILZEM 30MG TABLET

Take DILZEM 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DILZEM 30MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOKIND 5 TABLET

AMLOKIND 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOKIND 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOKIND 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOKIND 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOKIND 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOKIND 5 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOKIND 5 TABLET Works

AMLOKIND 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOKIND 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

warnings.details: The safety of AMLOKIND 5 TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMLOKIND 5 TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLOKIND 5 TABLET.
AMLOKIND 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLOKIND 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLOKIND 5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLOKIND 5 TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLOKIND 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLOKIND 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLOKIND 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLOKIND 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

name: Tenochek 25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET

TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET

TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET Works

TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

warnings.details: TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TENOCHEK 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation

introduction:
Introduction About INZIT 8MG TABLET

INZIT 8MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

INZIT 8MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking INZIT 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking INZIT 8MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking INZIT 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking INZIT 8MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNEP 10MG TABLET

CILNEP 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNEP 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNEP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNEP 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNEP 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNEP 10MG TABLET Works

CILNEP 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENIBUZ 8MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

If you or anyone else accidentally took more BENIBUZ 8MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:
Introduction About BENEPACK 8MG TABLET

BENEPACK 8MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENEPACK 8MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENEPACK 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENEPACK 8MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENEPACK 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking BENEPACK 8MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages chest pain associated with angina pectoris

mechanismOfAction:
How BENEPACK 8MG TABLET Works

BENEPACK 8MG TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

name: Stamlo 2.5mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET

STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET Works

STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

When to consult your doctor?

warnings.details: The safety of STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET.
STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
STAMLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

name: Samlokind AT Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SAMLOKIND AT TABLET

SAMLOKIND AT TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

Take SAMLOKIND AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking SAMLOKIND AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking SAMLOKIND AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

SAMLOKIND AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking SAMLOKIND AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking SAMLOKIND AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SAMLOKIND AT TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage angina (chest pain)
Prevents heart attack
mechanismOfAction:
How SAMLOKIND AT TABLET Works

SAMLOKIND AT TABLET contains two medicines namely S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use SAMLOKIND AT TABLET

Take SAMLOKIND AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. SAMLOKIND AT TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take SAMLOKIND AT TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: SAMLOKIND AT TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
SAMLOKIND AT TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking SAMLOKIND AT TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking SAMLOKIND AT TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
SAMLOKIND AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
SAMLOKIND AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take SAMLOKIND AT TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, S(-)Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
SAMLOKIND AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

SAMLOKIND AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of heart attack or heart failure in the recent days. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

SAMLOKIND AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking SAMLOKIND AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

Use in pediatrics:

SAMLOKIND AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

SAMLOKIND AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Amdepin 5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET

AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET Works

AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

sideEffects: Joint or muscle pain, back pain
Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing

Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET

Like all medicines, AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET:
Swelling of ankles
Headache, dizziness
Sleepiness, tiredness, muscle cramps
Palpitations (awareness of heart beat)
Flushing
Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, indigestion
Nausea
Altered bowel habits
Visual disturbances, double vision
Vomiting
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET.
AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMDEPIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.

More Information

When taking STAMLO 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like STAMLO 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your STAMLO 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

Before taking CILAHEART 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILACAR 20MG TABLET Works

CILACAR 20 Tablet contains cilnidipine, a calcium channel blocker that acts by relaxing the smooth muscle in the walls of blood vessels. This relaxation widens (dilates) the blood vessels, allowing blood to flow more easily and reducing the pressure exerted on the vessel walls. As a result, the heart does not have to work as hard to pump blood, which helps maintain healthy blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular function.

Blocks Calcium Channels for Vascular Relaxation

By blocking calcium channels, CILACAR 20 Tablet reduces calcium ion influx into vascular smooth muscle cells. This prevents the muscles from contracting tightly, leading to relaxation and dilation of blood vessels.

Supports Blood Vessel Relaxation and Improved Blood Flow

The relaxation of blood vessels improves blood flow throughout the body. Enhanced blood flow ensures that organs and tissues receive adequate oxygen and nutrients, which is essential for maintaining healthy cardiovascular function.

Reduces Strain on the Heart and Supports Cardiovascular Health

With blood vessels relaxed, the heart does not have to pump as hard to circulate blood. This reduces the workload on the heart, lowers the risk of heart-related complications, and supports overall heart health.

Inhibits Calcium Ion Influx to Lower Blood Pressure

The inhibition of calcium ion influx into vascular smooth muscle cells is central to the blood pressure-lowering effect of CILACAR 20 Tablet. By preventing calcium-mediated contraction, the drug maintains lower blood pressure.

Suppresses Norepinephrine Release for Stress Blood Pressure Control

Cilnidipine’s action on N-type calcium channels at sympathetic nerve endings reduces the release of norepinephrine. This suppresses the body’s stress response that would otherwise increase blood pressure, providing additional control over blood pressure spikes during stressful situations.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET Works

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure and angina (such as nifedipine, verapamil, diltiazem, enalapril, ramipril, metoprolol, clonidine)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection and to suppress immune functions (such as tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everlimus, cyclosporine)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat (Ex. amiodarone, digoxin, quinidine or disopyramide)
Adrenaline (a medicine used to stimulate the heart)
Indomethacin or ibuprofen (medicines used for pain relief)
Medicines used to manage nose or sinus congestion and other cold remedies (such as montelukast, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. insulin, metformin, glimepiride)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET, as it could lead to further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin and shortness of breath.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET

AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMLOPIN 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About CILAGARD 10MG TABLET

CILAGARD 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILAGARD 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILAGARD 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILAGARD 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILAGARD 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILAGARD 10MG TABLET Works

CILAGARD 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
