introduction:
Introduction About NICARDIA RETARD 20MG TABLET

Nicardia Retard 20mg Tablet is a prescription medication primarily used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and other cardiovascular conditions. It belongs to a class of drugs called calcium channel blockers that help relax and widen blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Nicardia Retard 20mg Tablet may be prescribed either on its own or in combination with other medications. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dosage and frequency based on your condition, ensuring you receive the correct amount to manage your condition. The dosage may be adjusted by your doctor depending on your response to the medication and your blood pressure levels. You can take the medication at any time of day, with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time every day. Ensure you take it as soon as you remove it from the package, as it is sensitive to light and may lose its effectiveness if left outside the pack for too long.

Continue taking this medication for the full duration recommended by your doctor, even if you feel fine. Do not stop it on your own, as high blood pressure often shows no symptoms, and discontinuing the medicine could worsen your condition. Staying active through regular exercise, losing weight, and maintaining a healthy diet will also assist in managing your blood pressure. Always follow your doctor's guidance while using this medication.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, headaches, swelling of the ankles, fatigue, unusual heartbeat (palpitations), flushing and constipation. If any of these symptom’s trouble you or persist, consult your doctor.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for guidance before taking it. Also, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are using, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Limit alcohol consumption while on this medication, as it may lower your blood pressure and cause dizziness or lightheadedness. It is important to have your blood pressure monitored regularly to ensure the medication is working effectively.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET

AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET Works

AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOPIN 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About DILZEM 60MG TABLET

DILZEM 60MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with DILZEM 60MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILZEM 60MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About BENGREAT 8MG TABLET

BENGREAT 8MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENGREAT 8MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENGREAT 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENGREAT 8MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENGREAT 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking BENGREAT 8MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

CETANIL 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CETANIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CETANIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CETANIL 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CETANIL 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Take NICARDIA XL 30 exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. Typically, it is taken once daily, swallowing the tablet whole with water. Do not crush or chew the tablet. Regular intake is important even if you start feeling better.

mechanismOfAction:
How NICARDIA XL 30 TABLET Works

Nifedipine, the active ingredient, blocks calcium entry into smooth muscle cells of blood vessels, causing them to relax and widen. This vasodilation lowers blood pressure and decreases cardiac workload, aiding in symptom control and disease management.

Mechanism of action of Nifedipine in NICARDIA XL 30
Nifedipine in NICARDIA XL 30 acts as a calcium channel blocker, specifically targeting the voltage-gated L-type calcium channels found primarily in the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels and the heart. By blocking the entry of calcium ions into these cells during depolarization, nifedipine reduces intracellular calcium levels, which is essential for muscle contraction. This inhibition causes relaxation and dilation of the arterial smooth muscle, leading to a decrease in peripheral vascular resistance and consequently lowering blood pressure
Nifedipine dilates coronary arteries, increasing oxygen delivery to the heart muscle, which helps alleviate angina symptoms by reducing ischemia. The extended-release formulation of NICARDIA XL 30 ensures a steady and sustained blockade of calcium channels, providing consistent blood pressure control throughout the day and minimizing blood pressure fluctuations that can trigger cardiovascular events

How to use NICARDIA XL 30 TABLET

Take NICARDIA XL 30 exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. Typically, it is taken once daily, swallowing the tablet whole with water. Do not crush or chew the tablet. Regular intake is important even if you start feeling better.

1. Recommended dosage of NICARDIA XL 30

The usual starting dose of NICARDIA XL 30 (Nifedipine extended-release 30 mg) is one tablet once daily. Your doctor may adjust this dose based on your blood pressure response and clinical condition. The maximum recommended dose typically does not exceed 90 mg per day

2. NICARDIA XL 30 administration tips

Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. Do not crush, chew, or break the tablet to ensure the extended-release effect is maintained. Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain steady blood levels and maximize effectiveness.

3. Can NICARDIA XL 30 Tablet be taken with food?

NICARDIA XL 30 can be taken with or without food. However, avoid grapefruit or grapefruit juice during treatment as they can increase the medication's effects and side effects by interfering with its metabolism.

4. NICARDIA XL 30 Tablet dosage for adults and elderly

The standard adult dose is usually 30 mg once daily. For elderly patients, dosage adjustments may be needed depending on their tolerance, kidney, and liver function. Always follow the prescribing doctor’s directions with regular blood pressure monitoring.

More Information
Practical advice for busy adults on integrating NICARDIA XL 30 intake with lifestyle modifications

1. Consistent Medication Routine:

Take NICARDIA XL 30 at the same time each day, ideally in the morning with or without food, to build a habit and maintain consistent blood levels. Using daily alarms or medication apps can help manage missed doses amidst a hectic schedule.

2. Simplify Dietary Changes:

Aim for gradual reduction of sodium by choosing fresh, unprocessed foods and limiting salty snacks. Meal prepping healthy options can save time and ensure adherence to a heart-friendly diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins.

3. Incorporate Physical Activity Efficiently:

Even short bouts of moderate activity like brisk walking, stair climbing, or stretching throughout the day can significantly aid blood pressure management. Consider active commuting, taking short activity breaks during work, or combining social time with physical activities.

4. Stress Management Techniques:

Utilize quick and effective stress relief practices such as deep breathing, mindfulness, or short meditation sessions, which can be done during breaks or before bedtime. Prioritize adequate sleep by establishing a relaxing nighttime routine despite a busy lifestyle.

5. Regular Monitoring and Health Check-ups:

Schedule blood pressure monitoring sessions that fit your routine, home monitoring devices or visits to local clinics help track progress and inform ongoing treatment adjustments.

How lifestyle stress impacts blood pressure and cardiovascular health?

Aspect

	

Effect of Lifestyle Stress

	

Impact on Blood Pressure and Cardiovascular Health




Hormonal Response

	

Stress triggers release of adrenaline and cortisol

	

Increased heart rate and blood vessel constriction lead to temporary rise in BP




Chronic Stress Hormones

	

Prolonged cortisol elevation promotes inflammation and plaque buildup

	

Sustained hypertension, atherosclerosis, increased risk of heart attack and stroke




Metabolic Effects

	

Stress increases blood sugar, cholesterol, and triglycerides

	

Contributes to cardiovascular risk and damage to blood vessels




Behavioral Consequences

	

Stress leads to smoking, poor diet, alcohol use, and physical inactivity

	

Unhealthy lifestyle factors worsen blood pressure and heart health




Cardiovascular Events

	

Acute stress can trigger arrhythmias and plaque rupture

	

Increased risk of heart attacks and stroke




Endothelial Dysfunction

	

Stress causes inflammation and impaired blood vessel lining function

	

Reduced vascular health and elevated blood pressure




Blood Pressure Regulation

	

Stress disrupts autonomic nervous system and baroreceptor reflexes

	

Poor blood pressure control, increased risk of chronic hypertension




Psychological and Physical Symptoms

	

Stress causes headaches, insomnia, anxiety, and fatigue

	

These symptoms can indirectly elevate blood pressure and complicate heart health




Overall Cardiovascular Risk

	

Combination of direct and indirect effects of stress

	

Increased incidence and severity of cardiovascular diseases

References to clinical studies, expert guidelines, and regulatory standards significantly enhances the credibility and confidence of content related to cardiovascular health and lifestyle stress management
A 2020 article published in Circulation (American Heart Association journal) emphasized that chronic psychosocial stress independently increases the risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) by more than two-fold, comparable to major risk factors like smoking and hypertension. The INTERHEART study involving over 24,000 patients from 52 countries confirmed the link between stress and myocardial infarction risk, independent of lifestyle or socioeconomic status.
Expert guidelines from the American Heart Association recommend screening for stress as part of cardiovascular risk assessment and incorporating structured stress management interventions in both primary and secondary prevention of CVD. These guidelines highlight the biological mechanisms such as neurohormonal activation and vascular inflammation through which stress exacerbates heart disease, reinforcing the need for integrated treatment approaches.
Clinical trials have demonstrated that reducing stress through regular exercise, meditation, and social support leads to improvements in blood pressure regulation, endothelial function, and inflammatory markers
Regulatory standards emphasize patient safety and evidence-based treatment strategies, encouraging healthcare providers to adopt a holistic approach that combines pharmacological management (e.g., NICARDIA XL 30) with lifestyle and psychological interventions to optimize cardiovascular outcomes

introduction:
Introduction About LNBLOC 10 TABLET

LNBLOC 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking LNBLOC 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

LNBLOC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking LNBLOC 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking LNBLOC 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How LNBLOC 10 TABLET Works

LNBLOC 10 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOSAFE H TABLET

AMLOSAFE H TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with AMLOSAFE H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOSAFE H TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLOSAFE H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOSAFE H TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOSAFE H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take AMLOSAFE H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CILDAY 10MG TABLET

CILDAY 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILDAY 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILDAY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILDAY 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILDAY 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILDAY 10MG TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How CILDAY 10MG TABLET Works

CILDAY 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageInstructions: Always take this medicine as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily.
Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.
Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

name: Eslo 5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESLO 5MG TABLET

ESLO 5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESLO 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESLO 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESLO 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESLO 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESLO 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESLO 5MG TABLET

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How ESLO 5MG TABLET Works

ESLO 5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.
usageDetails:
How to use ESLO 5MG TABLET

Take ESLO 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of ESLO 5MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Beniduce 4mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET

BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Manage and manages chest pain associated with angina pectoris

mechanismOfAction:
How BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET Works

BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

Take BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET preferably after meals. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking BENIDUCE 4MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNY M 25 TABLET

CILNY M 25 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CILNY M 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, or gout as a precaution.

CILNY M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNY M 25 TABLET Works

CILNY M 25 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines, namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Take CILNY M 25 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About UNIAZ 8MG TABLET

UNIAZ 8MG TABLET contains Azelnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is indicated for the management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension. Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease or stroke.

Stage I hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 130 to 139 mm Hg or a diastolic pressure ranging from 80 to 89 mm Hg. Stage II hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 140 mm Hg or higher or a diastolic pressure ranging from 90 mm Hg or higher.

Along management with UNIAZ 8MG TABLET, your doctor might advise you to follow certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy diet, taking adequate sleep, weight and stress management and avoid smoking or drinking alcohol.    

Before taking UNIAZ 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney diseases or any other medical conditions. introduction:
Introduction About CETANIL 20MG TABLET

CETANIL 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CETANIL 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CETANIL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CETANIL 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CETANIL 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How CETANIL 20MG TABLET Works

CETANIL 20MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About DILZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE

Dilzem CD 90mg capsule is a calcium channel blocker widely used to manage cardiovascular conditions such as hypertension (high blood pressure), angina (heart-related chest pain), and certain types of irregular heart rhythms (arrhythmias). By relaxing and widening blood vessels, it improves blood flow and reduces the workload on the heart, which helps lower blood pressure and ease chest pain. The medication plays a crucial role in preventing complications related to high blood pressure, like strokes or heart attacks, and supports overall heart health.

It is ideal for patients diagnosed with high blood pressure or angina who require a medication to control their symptoms in conjunction with lifestyle changes such as a healthy diet and regular exercise. It may also be prescribed for patients experiencing abnormal heart rhythms. It is not typically recommended for people with heart block, severe heart failure, or those allergic to diltiazem. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should use this medication only under strict medical supervision due to limited safety data.

The capsule should be taken once daily at the same time, with or without food, as prescribed by a healthcare professional. It must be swallowed whole without crushing or chewing to maintain its extended-release mechanism. Patients are advised not to stop the medication abruptly, as this may worsen their condition. Consistency in dosing supports stable heart function and optimal blood pressure control.

Important precautions include monitoring for side effects such as dizziness, headache, nausea, or swelling, which usually improve over time but should be reported if persistent. Patients should avoid alcohol as it can increase side effects like dizziness or low blood pressure. Those with liver or kidney issues should inform their doctor for careful dose adjustments. Use during pregnancy and breastfeeding requires medical consultation. Following these directions and cautionary advice helps ensure the safe and effective use of Dilzem CD 90mg capsule for cardiovascular support.

mechanismOfAction:
How DILZEM CD 90MG CAPSULE Works
Dilzem CD 90mg Mechanism of Action

Dilzem CD 90mg works by blocking L-type calcium channels in the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. Calcium ions play a crucial role in muscle contraction; by limiting calcium entry, Dilzem relaxes the vascular smooth muscles, causing blood vessels to widen. This reduces the pressure against which the heart pumps, lowering blood pressure and decreasing cardiac workload. It also slows electrical conduction through the heart’s atrioventricular node, helping to regulate heart rate and rhythm. Together, these actions reduce myocardial oxygen demand and improve blood flow.

Blood Vessel Dilation Mechanism

Dilzem CD induces blood vessel dilation by relaxing the smooth muscle lining the arteries. This occurs because the drug inhibits calcium influx required for muscle contraction. As the muscles relax, the arteries widen or dilate, decreasing resistance to blood flow. The dilation allows blood to circulate more freely and reduces the load on the heart. This vasodilation effect occurs in both coronary arteries supplying the heart and systemic arteries throughout the body, contributing to lowered blood pressure and enhanced oxygen delivery.

Heart Rate Regulation by Dilzem

Dilzem CD influences heart rate by acting on the heart’s electrical conduction system, particularly the atrioventricular (AV) node. It slows down the passage of electrical impulses through the AV node, which results in a slower, more regular heartbeat. This helps control arrhythmias like supraventricular tachycardia and reduces the heart’s workload. By lowering the heart rate along with dilating blood vessels, Dilzem decreases myocardial oxygen consumption and supports better heart efficiency and patient symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET

AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET.
AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLIP 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

name: AMLOPRIDE AT Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET

AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET

AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET Works

AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

AMLOPRIDE AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

name: BENEPACK 4mg Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About BENEPACK 4MG TABLET

BENEPACK 4MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENEPACK 4MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENEPACK 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENEPACK 4MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. introduction:
Introduction About BENIDUCE 8MG TABLET

BENIDUCE 8MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENIDUCE 8MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENIDUCE 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENIDUCE 8MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENIDUCE 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking BENIDUCE 8MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: DILNIP 10 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About DILNIP 10 TABLET

DILNIP 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking DILNIP 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

DILNIP 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking DILNIP 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking DILNIP 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:

Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How DILNIP 10 TABLET Works

DILNIP 10 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

ESPIN 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESPIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESPIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESPIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESPIN 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About NATRILAM 5MG TABLET

NATRILAM 5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Indapamide, which belong to the group of medicines called Calcium-channel blockers and Thiazide diuretics. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension), which is a condition in which the force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries, which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver or heart. If you are elderly and younger than 18 years old, you should consult with a doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking NATRILAM 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any conditions such as diabetes, low blood pressure, gout, low levels of potassium in the blood (hypokalaemia) and symptoms of fluid accumulation around the eye that present with visual disturbances or eye pain. The most common side effects of taking NATRILAM 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, dizziness and tiredness.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NATRILAM 5MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How NATRILAM 5MG TABLET Works

NATRILAM 5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle, resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Indapamide reduces blood pressure by promoting the excretion of extra fluid and certain salts (sodium) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys.

Always take NATRILAM 5MG TABLET as instructed by your doctor. Take NATRILAM 5MG TABLET with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not stop taking the medicine without informing your doctor.

Others

Do not take NATRILAM 5MG TABLET, if you have:

Hepatic encephalopathy
Severe low blood pressure

Before taking NATRILAM 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe increase in blood pressure
Diabetes
Gout (joint pain and swelling)
Allergic problems with natural sunlight or UV rays (photosensitivity reactions)
Symptoms of fluid accumulation in the vascular layer of the eye (choroidal effusion) or increase in eye pressure such as eye pain or low eye vision

NATRILAM 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice.

NATRILAM 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients and the dose may be adjusted according to age and weight. The management should be initiated based on kidney, liver or heart function.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLODAC 10MG TABLET

AMLODAC 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLODAC 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLODAC 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLODAC 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLODAC 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLODAC 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLODAC 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLODAC 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLODAC 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLODAC 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLODAC 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLODAC 10MG TABLET Works

AMLODAC 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMLODAC 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLODAC 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLODAC 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLODAC 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET

AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET Works

AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET.
AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLOPRES 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About DILZEM SR TABLET

DILZEM SR TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

During management with DILZEM SR TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILZEM SR TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILZEM SR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILZEM SR TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILZEM SR TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DILZEM SR TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How DILZEM SR TABLET Works

DILZEM SR TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use DILZEM SR TABLET

Take DILZEM SR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DILZEM SR TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About AZELDIP 16 TABLET

AZELDIP 16 TABLET contains Azelnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is indicated for the management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension. Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease or stroke.

Stage I hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 130 to 139 mm Hg or a diastolic pressure ranging from 80 to 89 mm Hg. Stage II hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 140 mm Hg or higher or a diastolic pressure ranging from 90 mm Hg or higher.

Along management with AZELDIP 16 TABLET, your doctor might advise you to follow certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy diet, taking adequate sleep, weight and stress management and avoid smoking or drinking alcohol.    

Before taking AZELDIP 16 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney diseases or any other medical conditions. Your doctor might ask you to take some blood tests before initiating the management with AZELDIP 16 TABLET to understand the existing condition and for proper use of this medicine.

AZELDIP 16 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who has a possibility to conceive, and breast-feeding women. AZELDIP 16 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.   

Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice while taking AZELDIP 16 TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure. The most common side effects of taking AZELDIP 16 TABLET are dizziness, light-headedness, nausea, constipation, fatigue and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension
usesDetails:
Uses Of AZELDIP 16 TABLET
Management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How AZELDIP 16 TABLET Works

AZELDIP 16 TABLET works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles.
usageDetails:

Take AZELDIP 16 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. introduction:
Introduction About AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET

AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

Flushing

Nausea

When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET.
AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLODAC 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About ESAMLOVIN N TABLET

ESAMLOVIN N TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Nebivolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to manage angina and heart failure.

Take ESAMLOVIN N TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking ESAMLOVIN N TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ESAMLOVIN N TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (such as angina). You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, thyroid problems, poor blood circulation or psoriasis as a precaution.

ESAMLOVIN N TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart failure or heart block). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ESAMLOVIN N TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, tingling sensation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Manage and manages angina and heart failure
usesDetails:

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina and heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ESAMLOVIN N TABLET Works

ESAMLOVIN N TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also slows down the heart rate and reduces the force of contraction of heart muscles. As a result, it reduces the strain on the heart, improves blood flow across the blood vessels and makes the heart to pump blood more smoothly and efficiently with less pressure.

Take ESAMLOVIN N TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take ESAMLOVIN N TABLET at the same time each day. ESAMLOVIN N TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take ESAMLOVIN N TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.
