ESAMLOVIN N TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, slow heartbeat, serious heart rhythm problems, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having angina (chest pain) or heart block. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ESAMLOVIN N TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure
Have poor blood circulation in the arms and legs
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma

Before taking ESAMLOVIN N TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have a slow heartbeat with shortness of breath and dizziness
Have Raynaud’s disease (poor blood circulation to fingers and toes)
Have leg pain, tension or weakness (intermittent claudication)
Have diabetes
Have overactivity of thyroid gland
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Are going to undergo an operation
Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)

Use in Pediatrics:

ESAMLOVIN N TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

ESAMLOVIN N TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About RANCIL 20MG TABLET

RANCIL 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking RANCIL 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

RANCIL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking RANCIL 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking RANCIL 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How RANCIL 20MG TABLET Works

RANCIL 20MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Introduction About AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET

AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET Works

AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLOVIN 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

Introduction About DILZEM CD 120MG CAPSULE

DILZEM CD 120MG CAPSULE contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with DILZEM CD 120MG CAPSULE your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILZEM CD 120MG CAPSULE as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILZEM CD 120MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILZEM CD 120MG CAPSULE is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILZEM CD 120MG CAPSULE are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: Trilopace Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRILOPACE TABLET

TRILOPACE TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Hydrochlorothiazide and Losartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

It also helps in reducing the risk of heart attack, heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

During management with TRILOPACE TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TRILOPACE TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TRILOPACE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

TRILOPACE TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TRILOPACE TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking TRILOPACE TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack or stroke
Protects kidney functions in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRILOPACE TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)

mechanismOfAction:
How TRILOPACE TABLET Works

TRILOPACE TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure. It also protects kidney functions by improving blood supply to the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use TRILOPACE TABLET

Take TRILOPACE TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take TRILOPACE TABLET at the same time each day. TRILOPACE TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take TRILOPACE TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking TRILOPACE TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TRILOPACE TABLET, stop taking it and consult your doctor immediately.
TRILOPACE TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking TRILOPACE TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRILOPACE TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

TRILOPACE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TRILOPACE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TRILOPACE TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Losartan or Hydrochlorothiazide.
TRILOPACE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with breathing problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TRILOPACE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious heart problem (such as heart failure or heart attack). It should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm and problems with heart muscles or valves). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TRILOPACE TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have diabetes related kidney problems
Have low blood sodium or potassium levels
Have high blood calcium levels
Have severe gout (painful joints)

Before taking TRILOPACE TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Have low blood pressure
Are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Are on a low-salt diet
Have diabetes
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)
Have unstable angina (a type of chest pain)
Have narrowing of arteries
Have had skin cancer
Have had gout in the past

Use in Pediatrics:

TRILOPACE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

TRILOPACE TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About CILNIBLU 10MG TABLET

CILNIBLU 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNIBLU 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNIBLU 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNIBLU 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIBLU 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Introduction About OLVAN TRIO 20MG TABLET

OLVAN TRIO 20MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels.

Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

OLVAN TRIO 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking.

OLVAN TRIO 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breastmilk to the baby. Consult your doctor for advice.

Safety and efficacy in pediatric patients is not established. Consult your doctor before taking. OLVAN TRIO 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients of 65 years and above. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking OLVAN TRIO 20MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About AMCARD 10MG TABLET

AMCARD 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMCARD 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMCARD 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMCARD 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMCARD 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMCARD 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMCARD 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMCARD 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMCARD 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMCARD 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMCARD 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMCARD 10MG TABLET Works

AMCARD 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMCARD 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMCARD 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMCARD 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMCARD 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMCARD 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About BENITOWA 8 TABLET

BENITOWA 8 TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENITOWA 8 TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENITOWA 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENITOWA 8 TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENITOWA 8 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking BENITOWA 8 TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How BENITOWA 8 TABLET Works

BENITOWA 8 TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. introduction:
Introduction About UNIAZ T 40 TABLET

UNIAZ T 40 TABLET is a combination of Azelnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage stage II hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, UNIAZ T 40 TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) and stroke. During management with UNIAZ T 40 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking UNIAZ T 40 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea. Avoid taking grapefruit juice while taking this medicine as it may reduce the risk of side effects.

UNIAZ T 40 TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking UNIAZ T 40 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with UNIAZ T 40 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking UNIAZ T 40 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage Stage II Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents the risk of heart attack and stroke
usesDetails:
Uses Of UNIAZ T 40 TABLET
Manage Stage II Hypertension (high blood pressure)

mechanismOfAction:
How UNIAZ T 40 TABLET Works

UNIAZ T 40 TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Azelnidipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Azelnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use UNIAZ T 40 TABLET

Take UNIAZ T 40 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take UNIAZ T 40 TABLET at the same time each day. UNIAZ T 40 TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking UNIAZ T 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

CILNY 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNY 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNY 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNY 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About DEPIN RETARD TABLET

DEPIN RETARD TABLET contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

DEPIN RETARD TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

DEPIN RETARD TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking DEPIN RETARD TABLET are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ALSARTAN AM TABLET

ALSARTAN AM TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

Used to manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How ALSARTAN AM TABLET Works

ALSARTAN AM TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan where Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker and losartan belong to angiotensin II receptor blocker they collectively function as a vasodilator. It acts by widening of the blood vessels as a result it enhances the blood flow to all parts of the body easily, thereby causing reduction in blood pressure level.

Take ALSARTAN AM TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET

DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain and muscle tremors (shakiness).

DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney and heart disease. DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

usesDetails:
Uses Of DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET
Manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure) in adults

mechanismOfAction:
How DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET Works

DILNIP TRIO 6.25 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body which causes the narrowing of blood vessels).

introduction:
Introduction About AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET

AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure), angina, irregular heart rhythm and long-term heart failure.

You can take AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue using the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Do not stop taking it on your own, even if you feel fine, as high blood pressure often shows no symptoms, and discontinuing it may worsen your condition. To enhance the effectiveness of the medication, follow your doctor’s advice and adopt healthy lifestyle habits such as regular exercise, maintaining a healthy weight, and eating a balanced diet.

Avoid taking grapefruit or its juice while taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.

Before starting this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney conditions. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine. Also, let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking, especially those used for blood pressure or heart-related issues, to avoid potential interactions.

Common side effects of this medicine include headache, swelling in the ankles, skin rash, slow heart rate, nausea, and depression. It may also cause dizziness, so avoid driving or engaging in activities that require concentration until you understand how it affects you. Additionally, it can increase potassium levels in the blood, so you should avoid potassium-rich foods and supplements unless advised otherwise. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels may be necessary during treatment.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET Works

AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Metoprolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart beat more easily thus lowering the blood pressure.
usageInstructions: Take AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it.
You can take AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET with or without food, but it’s important to take it at the same time each day to help maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow your doctor’s guidance regarding the appropriate dose and duration based on your condition.
Do not miss doses or discontinue the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel fine, as stopping suddenly can cause your blood pressure to spike.
Regularly check your blood pressure to make sure the medication is working as intended.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it’s almost time for your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and resume your usual dosing schedule.

Side Effects Of AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET

Like all medicines, AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them

Most Common Side Effects of AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET are:
Swelling of ankles, hands and feet
Headache, dizziness
Slow heart rate
Feeling faint on standing due to low blood pressure
Stomach upset
Muscle cramps
Mood changes, anxiety, sleeplessness, depression
Numbness or tingling sensation in your limbs, loss of pain sensation
Low blood pressure
Increased need to urinate at night
Inability to obtain an erection, discomfort or enlargement of the breasts in men
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
Weight increase or decrease

Stop taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction (such as itching, difficulty breathing or swelling of the face, lips, throat or tongue)
Wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Severe skin reactions including intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over the whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reaction
Abnormal heartbeat, heart attack

warnings.details: AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to lack of safety data. While there are limited human studies, animal research has shown potential harmful effects on a developing baby. Your doctor will carefully assess the benefits and possible risks before prescribing this medication to you. Please consult with your doctor for further guidance.
AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not suitable for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience tiredness or dizziness while taking this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.
AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease or failure. Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET.

AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver cirrhosis. Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET.

Do not take AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Amlodipine or Metoprolol. It should be used with caution in patients with history of allergic reactions such as insect stings, foods or other substances.

AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties or asthma including COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease-causing cough, wheezing or breathlessness, phlegm or increase in chest infections). Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET.

AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure, shock caused by heart problems, heart attack, prinzmetal’s angina (suffering from a tight, painful feeling in the chest in periods of rest). AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with controlled heart failure and slow heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET.
AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above) usually, the management will be initiated with a lower dosage by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET.

Others

AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Blocked blood vessels including blood circulation problems (which may cause your fingers and toes to tingle or turn pale or blue)
Unmanageed phaeochromocytoma
Metabolic acidosis
Low blood pressure
Diabetes is associated with frequent episodes of low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)

Before taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Diabetes mellitus
Blood vessel disorder
Manageed phaeochromocytoma (high blood pressure due to a tumour near the kidney)
Psoriasis (severe skin rashes)
Myasthenia gravis
Dry eyes
Hypertensive crisis (severe increase in blood pressure)

Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice and grapefruit while taking AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET, this is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure-lowering effect of AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of AMLODAC M 50/5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Introduction About RANCIL 10MG TABLET

RANCIL 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking RANCIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

RANCIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking RANCIL 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking RANCIL 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXOVAS CH TABLET

NEXOVAS CH TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels. Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

NEXOVAS CH TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease and it should be used in caution with patient having diabetes.

NEXOVAS CH TABLET is not intended for use in the pregnant and breast-feeding woman. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

As safety and efficacy in children has not been established, consult your doctor about the risk and benefits before taking NEXOVAS CH TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking NEXOVAS CH TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects are not improving.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)

Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How NEXOVAS CH TABLET Works

NEXOVAS CH TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction.

Take NEXOVAS CH TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Amlong 2.5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET

AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.

AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. AMLONG 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About LNBLOC 20 TABLET

LNBLOC 20 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking LNBLOC 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

LNBLOC 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking LNBLOC 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking LNBLOC 20 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How LNBLOC 20 TABLET Works

LNBLOC 20 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) or stroke. It can also be used to manage angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to low oxygen supply).

During management with NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET Works

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, S(-)Amlodipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET

Take NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET at the same time each day. NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

If you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET, stop taking it and consult your doctor immediately.
NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to S(-)Amlodipine or Telmisartan.

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm, heart failure, recent heart attack, and problems with heart muscle or valves). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have diabetes related kidney problems

Before taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Have low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have diabetes
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)
Have unstable angina (a type of chest pain)
Have narrowing of arteries

Use in pediatrics:

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage elevated blood pressure (such as aliskiren, captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, verapamil, diltiazem, losartan, valsartan)
Lithium, St. John’s wort (medicines used to manage depression)
Potassium supplements or potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride (used to retain or increase potassium levels in the body)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (used for pain relief) such as indomethacin, celecoxib, ibuprofen, aspirin
Heparin (a medicine used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin, telithromycin, trimethoprim)
Medicines to suppress immune system (Ex. cyclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus and everolimus)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasm)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir, saquinavir)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. itraconazole, ketoconazole and fluconazole)
Digoxin (a medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Simvastatin (a medicine used to lower blood cholesterol levels)
Baclofen (a medicine used for relaxing muscles)
Amifostine (a kidney protectant used along with chemotherapeutic agents)
Medicines used to manage mental disorders such as depression, psychosis, or anxiety (Ex. pimozide, amisulpride, haloperidol)
Corticosteroids (used to manage inflammation) Ex. prednisolone

B. Drug-Food interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while taking NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more NUMLO TM 2.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Overdosage may cause low blood pressure, abnormal heartbeat, and dizziness.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET

AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMLOGARD 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

Introduction About EFONTA 40MG TABLET

EFONTA 40MG TABLET contains Efonidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. EFONTA 40MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) which occurs when force exerted by the circulating blood against the blood vessel wall is high.

[GBNKEYOWRD] is also used to manage high blood pressure that occurs due to kidney diseases in affected individuals. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage angina (chest pain) that occurs when blood flow to the heart is low.   

EFONTA 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Efonidipine.

Before taking EFONTA 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart disease (such as heart attack, heart failure liver), kidney disease (such as renal impairment), and/or liver disease.  

EFONTA 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breast-feeding women.

EFONTA 40MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of taking EFONTA 40MG TABLET are hot flushes, palpitations, facial flushing, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEBLONG 16 TABLET

ZEBLONG 16 TABLET contains Azelnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is indicated for the management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension. Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease or stroke.

Stage I hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 130 to 139 mm Hg or a diastolic pressure ranging from 80 to 89 mm Hg. Stage II hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 140 mm Hg or higher or a diastolic pressure ranging from 90 mm Hg or higher.

Along management with ZEBLONG 16 TABLET, your doctor might advise you to follow certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy diet, taking adequate sleep, weight and stress management and avoid smoking or drinking alcohol.    

Before taking ZEBLONG 16 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney diseases or any other medical conditions. Your doctor might ask you to take some blood tests before initiating the management with ZEBLONG 16 TABLET to understand the existing condition and for proper use of this medicine.

ZEBLONG 16 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who has a possibility to conceive, and breast-feeding women. ZEBLONG 16 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.   

Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice while taking ZEBLONG 16 TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure. The most common side effects of taking ZEBLONG 16 TABLET are dizziness, light-headedness, nausea, constipation, fatigue and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET

AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.

AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLOVAS 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

Introduction About OLMEVAC 10 TABLET

Olmesar 20mg Tablet contains Olmesartan medoxomil, an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) designed to help manage high blood pressure. By supporting vessel relaxation, it allows smoother blood flow and reduces heart workload. Regular use, as advised by a healthcare provider, fits into daily routines for ongoing blood pressure management.

Olmesartan blocks the effects of angiotensin II, a substance that tightens blood vessels. This leads to vessel relaxation and improved circulation, helping to control blood pressure over time.

Before taking Olmesar 20mg, inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver issues, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women. Avoid use with certain medicines and always review your current list with a healthcare provider.

Your doctor may advice you to take regular exercise such as walking or swimming, low salt diet, giving up smoking and alcohol drinking, which helps to reduce blood pressure effectively during management with this medicine.

If you experience dizziness or persistent side effects like headache or stomach pain, seek medical advice. Olmesar 20mg is not recommended for those with known allergies to its ingredients or during pregnancy without supervision.
uses: Used to manage high blood pressure
usesDetails:
