Used to manage high blood pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How OLMEVAC 10 TABLET Works

Olmesar 20mg Tablet supports blood pressure control primarily by blocking the vasoconstrictive effects of angiotensin II, a hormone that normally narrows blood vessels. Olmesartan selectively binds to angiotensin type 1 (AT1) receptors on vascular smooth muscle and adrenal glands. By managing angiotensin II from binding to these receptors, Olmesar causes blood vessels to relax (vasodilation), reducing the resistance against which the heart must pump and thereby lowering blood pressure. This competitive inhibition of AT1 receptors also reduces aldosterone secretion, which decreases sodium and water retention, further helping in blood pressure regulation.

The physiological effects of Olmesar contribute not only to lowering blood pressure but also to improving heart and kidney function by decreasing the workload on these organs. Clinical data show that Olmesar exhibits a rapid onset of action, with significant blood pressure reduction often observed within two weeks of treatment.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXOVAS 10 TABLET

NEXOVAS 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking NEXOVAS 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

NEXOVAS 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking NEXOVAS 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking NEXOVAS 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How NEXOVAS 10 TABLET Works

NEXOVAS 10 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Introduction About NATCOCIL M TABLET

NATCOCIL M TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking NATCOCIL M TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

NATCOCIL M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How NATCOCIL M TABLET Works

NATCOCIL M TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Take NATCOCIL M TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET

EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET contains Efonidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) which occurs when force exerted by the circulating blood against the blood vessel wall is high.

[GBNKEYOWRD] is also used to manage high blood pressure that occurs due to kidney diseases in affected individuals. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage angina (chest pain) that occurs when blood flow to the heart is low.   

EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Efonidipine.

Before taking EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart disease (such as heart attack, heart failure liver), kidney disease (such as renal impairment), and/or liver disease.  

EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breast-feeding women.

EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of taking EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET are hot flushes, palpitations, facial flushing, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: High blood pressure caused by kidney disease

mechanismOfAction:
How EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET Works

EFNOCAR 20MG TABLET helps in the management of high blood pressure by acting on certain receptors which leads to relaxation of the blood vessels, aiding in easy flow of the blood and decreased heart rate. In angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is prevented. It also reduces the pressure on kidneys, thus managing the damage that is normally associated with high blood pressure.

Introduction About ESLO 2.5MG TABLET

ESLO 2.5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESLO 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESLO 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How ESLO 2.5MG TABLET Works

ESLO 2.5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

introduction:
Introduction About CILAHT 10 TABLET

CILAHT 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILAHT 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILAHT 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILAHT 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILAHT 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How CILAHT 10 TABLET Works

CILAHT 10 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLIP AT TABLET

AMLIP AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLIP AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLIP AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLIP AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLIP AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLIP AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLIP AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLIP AT TABLET

AMLIP AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLIP AT TABLET Works

AMLIP AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Introduction About CILACAR 5MG TABLET

Cilacar 5mg Tablet contains Cilnidipine, which belongs to a class of medicines called calcium channel blockers. It is commonly prescribed by healthcare professionals for managing high blood pressure and related conditions.

Before taking CILACAR 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems and severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILACAR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Common side effects of taking CILACAR 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How CILACAR 5MG TABLET Works
Action on Blood Vessels (L-type channels):
Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels by blocking L-type calcium channels.
This relaxation allows blood to flow more smoothly, which helps in maintaining stable blood pressure.
Action on Nerves Controlling Blood Pressure (N-type channels):
Unlike many calcium channel blockers, Cilnidipine also works on N-type calcium channels.
This reduces excess nerve activity that can raise blood pressure levels, providing a gentler control on circulation.

introduction:
Introduction About NEFIDINOL RETARD 20 TABLET

NEFIDINOL RETARD 20 TABLET contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

NEFIDINOL RETARD 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

NEFIDINOL RETARD 20 TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking NEFIDINOL RETARD 20 TABLET are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)

How NEFIDINOL RETARD 20 TABLET Works

NEFIDINOL RETARD 20 TABLET reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

Diabetic

name: AMLO 5 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About AMLO 5 TABLET

AMLO 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLO 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLO 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLO 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLO 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLO 5 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLO 5 TABLET Works

AMLO 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLO 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

warnings.details: The safety of AMLO 5 TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMLO 5 TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLO 5 TABLET.
AMLO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLO 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLO 5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLO 5 TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About CILDIP 10MG TABLET

CILDIP 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILDIP 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILDIP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILDIP 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILDIP 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILDIP 10MG TABLET Works

CILDIP 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

name: Triolsar HS 40mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET

TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to manage heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

It can also reduce the chances of fluid retention (edema) in the body that occurs due to some kidney or liver diseases. Take this medicine preferably in the mornings with food. While taking TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET, do not drink alcohol/grapefruit juice or go for a low-salt diet, as they may make further reduce your blood pressure. Consult your doctor for the best diet that can suit your health condition.

Before taking TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol levels, dehydration, or very low blood sodium, potassium or magnesium levels as a precaution.

TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves or cardiogenic shock. It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Do not take TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, tiredness, weakness, high blood uric acid levels, low blood sodium or magnesium levels, diabetes, high blood potassium levels, low blood pressure, impotence in men, sore throat, runny nose, cough, flu-like symptoms, urinary tract infections and increased blood cholesterol levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET

It is used to manage and prevent:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Heart failure, Stroke
Edema (fluid retention)
Kidney damage among diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET Works

TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET relaxes the blood vessels supplying various organs (such as heart, kidney, brain or others) which allows the blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also removes the excess fluids and electrolytes (sodium and water) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing edema and blood thickness. Collectively, these actions improve blood flow, reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET

Always take TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET is preferably taken during the mornings with food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking TRIOLSAR HS 40MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ESPIN AT TABLET

ESPIN AT TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

Take ESPIN AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking ESPIN AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking ESPIN AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

ESPIN AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking ESPIN AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESPIN AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESPIN AT TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage angina (chest pain)
Prevents heart attack
mechanismOfAction:
How ESPIN AT TABLET Works

ESPIN AT TABLET contains two medicines namely S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use ESPIN AT TABLET

Take ESPIN AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ESPIN AT TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ESPIN AT TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: Amtas 2.5mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMTAS 2.5MG TABLET

AMTAS 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMTAS 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMTAS 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMTAS 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMTAS 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

AMTAS 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLONG 10MG TABLET

AMLONG 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLONG 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLONG 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLONG 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLONG 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLONG 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLONG 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLONG 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLONG 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLONG 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLONG 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLONG 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLONG 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLONG 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

name: Esamlovin 1.25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET

ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET Works

ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.
usageDetails:
How to use ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET

Take ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage certain viral infections (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, miconazole)
Certain medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin, rifampicin)
Certain medicines used to lower blood pressure (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Dantrolene infusion (used to manage muscle stiffness)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection (Ex. tacrolimus, cyclosporine)
Simvastatin (used to reduce blood cholesterol)
St. john's wort (used to manage depression)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET as it may drop your blood pressure further. 

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ESAMLOVIN 1.25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The common symptoms of overdose are low blood pressure and fast heartbeat.

introduction:
Introduction About CILOVAS 10MG TABLET

CILOVAS 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILOVAS 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILOVAS 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILOVAS 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILOVAS 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:

Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How CILOVAS 10MG TABLET Works

CILOVAS 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About ASOMEX 5MG TABLET

ASOMEX 5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ASOMEX 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ASOMEX 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ASOMEX 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ASOMEX 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ASOMEX 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How ASOMEX 5MG TABLET Works

ASOMEX 5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

Take ASOMEX 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of ASOMEX 5MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nicardia Retard 10mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About NICARDIA RETARD 10MG TABLET

Nicardia Retard 10mg Tablet contains Nifedipine, a calcium channel blocker that supports smooth blood flow by relaxing blood vessels. It is often used for individuals with high blood pressure (hypertension) or certain heart-related concerns like chest discomfort due to restricted circulation. By reducing vascular tension, it eases the heart’s workload and enhances oxygen supply to tissues, making it a helpful choice for maintaining cardiovascular health under medical supervision.

Nicardia Retard 10mg is generally suitable for adults who require assistance in managing blood pressure or vascular stress. It may be considered for patients who experience frequent fluctuations in blood pressure or need short-term control to complement their long-term therapy. The tablet is typically taken after meals, swallowed whole with water, and at regular intervals as prescribed by the doctor to maintain consistent blood levels.

While using Nicardia Retard 10mg, it is important to follow all safety precautions. Avoid grapefruit juice, excessive alcohol, or high-sodium meals, as these can interfere with the medicine’s effectiveness. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and heart rate is recommended. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should use this medicine only under strict medical advice, as the doctor will weigh potential benefits against possible risks.

Common side effects may include headache, dizziness, facial flushing, mild nausea, or ankle swelling. These effects are often temporary, but if severe symptoms like sudden chest pain, rapid heartbeat, fainting, or breathing difficulty occur, immediate medical attention is necessary. Following a heart-healthy lifestyle, taking the medication as directed, and attending routine follow-ups can help maximize the benefits of Nicardia Retard 10mg.

mechanismOfAction:
How NICARDIA RETARD 10MG TABLET Works
Nicardia Retard 10mg Mechanism of Action

Nicardia Retard 10mg contains Nifedipine, a calcium channel blocker. It works by blocking the entry of calcium ions into the smooth muscles of blood vessel walls. This relaxation of blood vessels allows blood to flow more freely, reducing the strain on the heart. By lowering the resistance in the arteries, it supports smooth circulation and helps in maintaining healthier blood pressure levels.

Nicardia Retard 10mg Action in Blood Vessels

Nicardia Retard 10mg primarily acts on arterial blood vessels. By relaxing these vessels, it reduces vascular tension and increases the diameter of the arteries. This action improves blood flow, eases the heart’s pumping effort, and enhances oxygen delivery to body tissues. The effect on blood vessels also helps in reducing episodes of pressure-related discomfort and promotes overall circulatory health.

 Swallow the tablet whole with water – Do not crush, chew, or break it, as this may affect the slow-release action.

 Preferably take after meals – This helps reduce the risk of stomach discomfort or sudden dizziness.

 Take at the same time every day – Maintaining a routine ensures a steady effect in the body.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOSAFE AT TABLET

AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLOSAFE AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOSAFE AT TABLET

AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOSAFE AT TABLET Works

AMLOSAFE AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AMLOSAFE AT TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure and angina (such as nifedipine, verapamil, diltiazem, enalapril, ramipril, metoprolol, clonidine)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection and to suppress immune functions (such as tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everlimus, cyclosporine)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat (Ex. amiodarone, digoxin, quinidine or disopyramide)
Adrenaline (a medicine used to stimulate the heart)
Indomethacin or ibuprofen (medicines used for pain relief)
Medicines used to manage nose or sinus congestion and other cold remedies (such as montelukast, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. insulin, metformin, glimepiride)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, as it could lead to further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin and shortness of breath.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET

AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMLOVIN 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

name: Twincal 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TWINCAL 10MG TABLET

TWINCAL 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking TWINCAL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

TWINCAL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking TWINCAL 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking TWINCAL 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of TWINCAL 10MG TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How TWINCAL 10MG TABLET Works

TWINCAL 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageInstructions: Always take this medicine as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGICAM BETA TABLET

ANGICAM BETA TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take ANGICAM BETA TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking ANGICAM BETA TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking ANGICAM BETA TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

ANGICAM BETA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking ANGICAM BETA TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ANGICAM BETA TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANGICAM BETA TABLET

ANGICAM BETA TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ANGICAM BETA TABLET Works

ANGICAM BETA TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

ANGICAM BETA TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ANGICAM BETA TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking ANGICAM BETA TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET

AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET Works

AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOSAFE 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About AZELIREN 16 TABLET

AZELIREN 16 TABLET contains Azelnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is indicated for the management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension. Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease or stroke.

Stage I hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 130 to 139 mm Hg or a diastolic pressure ranging from 80 to 89 mm Hg. Stage II hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 140 mm Hg or higher or a diastolic pressure ranging from 90 mm Hg or higher.

Along management with AZELIREN 16 TABLET, your doctor might advise you to follow certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy diet, taking adequate sleep, weight and stress management and avoid smoking or drinking alcohol.    

Before taking AZELIREN 16 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney diseases or any other medical conditions. Your doctor might ask you to take some blood tests before initiating the management with AZELIREN 16 TABLET to understand the existing condition and for proper use of this medicine.

AZELIREN 16 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who has a possibility to conceive, and breast-feeding women. AZELIREN 16 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.   

Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice while taking AZELIREN 16 TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure. introduction:
Introduction About AMLIP 10MG TABLET

AMLIP 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLIP 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLIP 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLIP 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLIP 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLIP 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLIP 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLIP 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLIP 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLIP 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLIP 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLIP 10MG TABLET Works

AMLIP 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLIP 10MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMLIP 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMLIP 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLIP 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLIP 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLIP 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking PRIMODIL 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like PRIMODIL 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your PRIMODIL 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

Introduction About AMLONG MT 50 TABLET

AMLONG MT 50 TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage (hypertension). It is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high which is characterized by symptoms such as headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety and chest pain.

During management with AMLONG MT 50 TABLET practice regular exercise (such as walking), eating healthy and salt-restricted diet and managing weight will also help to control your blood pressure effectively. Avoid taking grapefruit or its juice while taking AMLONG MT 50 TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure lowering effect of this medicine.

AMLONG MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lungs problems (such as asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease), kidney disease or failure, liver disease, heart problems (such as heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure), metabolic acidosis and low blood pressure.

Before taking AMLONG MT 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have controlled heart failure and slow heart rate, diabetes mellitus, blood vessel disorder, psoriasis (severe skin rashes), myasthenia gravis and hypertensive crisis (severe increase in blood pressure).

AMLONG MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. AMLONG MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLONG MT 50 TABLET Works

AMLONG MT 50 TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Metoprolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by the blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart to beat more easily thus it lowers the blood pressure.

How DILNIP M 25 TABLET Works

DILNIP M 25 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines, namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
