introduction:
Introduction About AMLONG 5MG TABLET

AMLONG 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLONG 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLONG 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLONG 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLONG 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLONG 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLONG 5MG TABLET Works

AMLONG 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

AMLONG 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLONG 5MG TABLET.
AMLONG 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLONG 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLONG 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. AMLONG 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLONG 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIDIP A TABLET

LUPIDIP A TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take LUPIDIP A TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking LUPIDIP A TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking LUPIDIP A TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

LUPIDIP A TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking LUPIDIP A TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking LUPIDIP A TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIDIP A TABLET

LUPIDIP A TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIDIP A TABLET Works

LUPIDIP A TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET

CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET Works

CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

Take CALCIGARD RETARD 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Wellamo AT Tablet 14'S
introduction:
Introduction About WELLAMO AT TABLET

WELLAMO AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take WELLAMO AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking WELLAMO AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking WELLAMO AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

WELLAMO AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking WELLAMO AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking WELLAMO AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of WELLAMO AT TABLET

WELLAMO AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How WELLAMO AT TABLET Works

WELLAMO AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

WELLAMO AT TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking WELLAMO AT TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking WELLAMO AT TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
WELLAMO AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
WELLAMO AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take WELLAMO AT TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
WELLAMO AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

WELLAMO AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
WELLAMO AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
WELLAMO AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

WELLAMO AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking WELLAMO AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

Introduction About STAMLO D TABLET

STAMLO D TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with STAMLO D TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking STAMLO D TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking STAMLO D TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO D TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking STAMLO D TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take STAMLO D TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Have diabetes
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have gout (painful joints)

STAMLO D TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

STAMLO D TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

name: BENEDINOL 4 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BENEDINOL 4 TABLET

BENEDINOL 4 TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENEDINOL 4 TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENEDINOL 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENEDINOL 4 TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENEDINOL 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENEDINOL 4 TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Manage and manages chest pain associated with angina pectoris
usesDetails:

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages chest pain associated with angina pectoris
Manage renal parenchymal hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How BENEDINOL 4 TABLET Works

BENEDINOL 4 TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.
usageDetails:

Take BENEDINOL 4 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take BENEDINOL 4 TABLET preferably after meals. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking BENEDINOL 4 TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About AZUSA 16 TABLET

AZUSA 16 TABLET contains Azelnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is indicated for the management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension. Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease or stroke.

Stage I hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 130 to 139 mm Hg or a diastolic pressure ranging from 80 to 89 mm Hg. Stage II hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 140 mm Hg or higher or a diastolic pressure ranging from 90 mm Hg or higher.

Along management with AZUSA 16 TABLET, your doctor might advise you to follow certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy diet, taking adequate sleep, weight and stress management and avoid smoking or drinking alcohol.    

Before taking AZUSA 16 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney diseases or any other medical conditions. Your doctor might ask you to take some blood tests before initiating the management with AZUSA 16 TABLET to understand the existing condition and for proper use of this medicine.

AZUSA 16 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who has a possibility to conceive, and breast-feeding women. AZUSA 16 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.   

Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice while taking AZUSA 16 TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure. The most common side effects of taking AZUSA 16 TABLET are dizziness, light-headedness, nausea, constipation, fatigue and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About CILAHEART 20 TABLET

CILAHEART 20 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILAHEART 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILAHEART 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILAHEART 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILAHEART 20 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Introduction About CILAGARD 20MG TABLET

CILAGARD 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILAGARD 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILAGARD 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILAGARD 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILAGARD 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How CILAGARD 20MG TABLET Works

As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET

AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET

AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET Works

AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals.
Your doctor will prescribe the correct dosage and duration based on your health condition.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

AMLOVAS AT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

introduction:
Introduction About PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET

PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET Works

PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET.
PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.

It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
PRIMODIL 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About CILAHEART 5 TABLET

CILAHEART 5 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILAHEART 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILAHEART 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILAHEART 5 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILAHEART 5 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILAHEART 5 TABLET Works

CILAHEART 5 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGICAM 2.5MG TABLET

ANGICAM 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take ANGICAM 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking ANGICAM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of ANGICAM 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking ANGICAM 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

name: Sustameto AM Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SUSTAMETO AM TABLET

SUSTAMETO AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure), angina, irregular heart rhythm and long-term heart failure.

You can take SUSTAMETO AM TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue using the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Do not stop taking it on your own, even if you feel fine, as high blood pressure often shows no symptoms, and discontinuing it may worsen your condition. To enhance the effectiveness of the medication, follow your doctor’s advice and adopt healthy lifestyle habits such as regular exercise, maintaining a healthy weight, and eating a balanced diet.

Avoid taking grapefruit or its juice while taking SUSTAMETO AM TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.

Before starting this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney conditions. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine. Also, let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking, especially those used for blood pressure or heart-related issues, to avoid potential interactions.

Common side effects of this medicine include headache, swelling in the ankles, skin rash, slow heart rate, nausea, and depression. It may also cause dizziness, so avoid driving or engaging in activities that require concentration until you understand how it affects you. Additionally, it can increase potassium levels in the blood, so you should avoid potassium-rich foods and supplements unless advised otherwise. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels may be necessary during treatment.
uses: Chronic heart failure (as an adjuvant therapy)

Hypertension

mechanismOfAction:
How SUSTAMETO AM TABLET Works

SUSTAMETO AM TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Metoprolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart beat more easily thus lowering the blood pressure.
usageInstructions: Take SUSTAMETO AM TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it.
You can take SUSTAMETO AM TABLET with or without food, but it’s important to take it at the same time each day to help maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow your doctor’s guidance regarding the appropriate dose and duration based on your condition.
Do not miss doses or discontinue the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel fine, as stopping suddenly can cause your blood pressure to spike.
Regularly check your blood pressure to make sure the medication is working as intended.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it’s almost time for your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and resume your usual dosing schedule.

warnings.details: SUSTAMETO AM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to lack of safety data. While there are limited human studies, animal research has shown potential harmful effects on a developing baby. Your doctor will carefully assess the benefits and possible risks before prescribing this medication to you. Please consult with your doctor for further guidance.
SUSTAMETO AM TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not suitable for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience tiredness or dizziness while taking this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with SUSTAMETO AM TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.
SUSTAMETO AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease or failure. Consult your doctor before taking SUSTAMETO AM TABLET.
SUSTAMETO AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver cirrhosis. Consult your doctor before taking SUSTAMETO AM TABLET.

Do not take SUSTAMETO AM TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Amlodipine or Metoprolol. It should be used with caution in patients with history of allergic reactions such as insect stings, foods or other substances.

SUSTAMETO AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties or asthma including COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease-causing cough, wheezing or breathlessness, phlegm or increase in chest infections). Consult your doctor before taking SUSTAMETO AM TABLET.

SUSTAMETO AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure, shock caused by heart problems, heart attack, prinzmetal’s angina (suffering from a tight, painful feeling in the chest in periods of rest). SUSTAMETO AM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with controlled heart failure and slow heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking SUSTAMETO AM TABLET.
SUSTAMETO AM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

SUSTAMETO AM TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above) usually, the management will be initiated with a lower dosage by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking SUSTAMETO AM TABLET.

Others

Blocked blood vessels including blood circulation problems (which may cause your fingers and toes to tingle or turn pale or blue)
Unmanageed phaeochromocytoma
Metabolic acidosis
Low blood pressure
Diabetes is associated with frequent episodes of low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)

Before taking SUSTAMETO AM TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Diabetes mellitus
Blood vessel disorder
Manageed phaeochromocytoma (high blood pressure due to a tumour near the kidney)
Psoriasis (severe skin rashes)
Myasthenia gravis
Dry eyes
Hypertensive crisis (severe increase in blood pressure)

introduction:
Introduction About CETANIL 5MG TABLET

CETANIL 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CETANIL 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CETANIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CETANIL 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CETANIL 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How CETANIL 5MG TABLET Works

CETANIL 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

name: Asomex TM 2.5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET

ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) or stroke. It can also be used to manage angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to low oxygen supply).

During management with ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack or stroke
usesDetails:
Uses Of ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage Angina (chest pain)
Prevents the risk of heart attack or stroke
mechanismOfAction:
How ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET Works

ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, S(-)Amlodipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET

Take ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET at the same time each day. ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take ASOMEX TM 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET

CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, or gout as a precaution.

CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Manage heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain), or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET

It is used to:

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain), or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET Works

CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines, namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageDetails:
How to use CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET

Take CILNIDIB M 25 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET

AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. How AMLOVAS AT 25MG TABLET Works

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

introduction:
Introduction About CILDIP 20MG TABLET

CILDIP 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILDIP 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILDIP 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILDIP 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILDIP 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILDIP 20MG TABLET Works

CILDIP 20MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET

AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET Works

AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMDEPIN 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About ESLO D TABLET

ESLO D TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with ESLO D TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ESLO D TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ESLO D TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking ESLO D TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESLO D TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESLO D TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ESLO D TABLET Works

ESLO D TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ESLO D TABLET

Take ESLO D TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ESLO D TABLET at the same time each day. ESLO D TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take ESLO D TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

warnings.details: ESLO D TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESLO D TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking ESLO D TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ESLO D TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
ESLO D TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESLO D TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ESLO D TABLET if you are allergic to S(-)Amlodipine or Hydrochlorothiazide.

ESLO D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ESLO D TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking ESLO D TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Are on a low sodium diet
Have diabetes
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have gout (painful joints)
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood

Use in Pediatrics:

ESLO D TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

ESLO D TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About ESAM 2.5MG TABLET

ESAM 2.5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESAM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESAM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESAM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESAM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESAM 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESAM 2.5MG TABLET Works

ESAM 2.5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

introduction:
Introduction About BENGREAT 4MG TABLET

BENGREAT 4MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENGREAT 4MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENGREAT 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENGREAT 4MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENGREAT 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENGREAT 4MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

BENGREAT 4MG TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

introduction:
Introduction About AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET

AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.

warnings.details: The safety of AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET.
AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMDEPIN 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET

ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

Take ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage angina (chest pain)
Prevents heart attack
mechanismOfAction:
How ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET Works

ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET contains two medicines namely S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET

Take ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, S(-)Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of heart attack or heart failure in the recent days. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

Use in pediatrics:

ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

ASOMEX AT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET

CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevent heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET Works

CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageDetails:
How to use CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET

Take CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Others

CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are in shock caused due to poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused due to blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)

Before taking CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are prone to allergic reactions very often (such as even for insect bites)
Have problems in blood circulation around the body (especially in fingers, arms and feet)
Have diabetes
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased thyroid hormones in the body)
Are severely dehydrated
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood
Are going to undergo an operation
Have gout
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Have edema (swelling of body parts)

CILACAR M 10/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
