Introduction About CILWIN 10 TABLET

CILWIN 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILWIN 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILWIN 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILWIN 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILWIN 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Introduction About NATRILAM 10MG TABLET

NATRILAM 10MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Indapamide, which belong to the group of medicines called Calcium-channel blockers and Thiazide diuretics. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension), which is a condition in which the force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries, which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver or heart. If you are elderly and younger than 18 years old, you should consult with a doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking NATRILAM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any conditions such as diabetes, low blood pressure, gout, low levels of potassium in the blood (hypokalaemia) and symptoms of fluid accumulation around the eye that present with visual disturbances or eye pain. The most common side effects of taking NATRILAM 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, dizziness and tiredness.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NATRILAM 10MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How NATRILAM 10MG TABLET Works

NATRILAM 10MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle, resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Indapamide reduces blood pressure by promoting the excretion of extra fluid and certain salts (sodium) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys.
usageDetails:

Always take NATRILAM 10MG TABLET as instructed by your doctor. Take NATRILAM 10MG TABLET with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not stop taking the medicine without informing your doctor.

Others

Hepatic encephalopathy
Severe low blood pressure

Before taking NATRILAM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe increase in blood pressure
Diabetes
Gout (joint pain and swelling)
Allergic problems with natural sunlight or UV rays (photosensitivity reactions)
Symptoms of fluid accumulation in the vascular layer of the eye (choroidal effusion) or increase in eye pressure such as eye pain or low eye vision

NATRILAM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

NATRILAM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients and the dose may be adjusted according to age and weight. The management should be initiated based on kidney, liver or heart function.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNY 5MG TABLET

CILNY 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNY 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNY 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNY 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNY 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNY 5MG TABLET Works

CILNY 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.
Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET

S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET Works

S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

Take S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of S AMLOSAFE 2.5MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIKEM BETA 2.5/10MG TABLET

CILNIKEM BETA 2.5/10MG TABLET is a combination of Nebivolol and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of essential hypertension that occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure, not because of a medical condition.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurry vision, chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, fatigue, mental confusion, nosebleed and severe headaches.

introduction:
Introduction About NICARDIA XL 60 TABLET

NICARDIA XL 60 TABLET contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

NICARDIA XL 60 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

NICARDIA XL 60 TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking NICARDIA XL 60 TABLET are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)

Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NICARDIA XL 60 TABLET Works

NICARDIA XL 60 TABLET reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLONG H TABLET

AMLONG H TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with AMLONG H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLONG H TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLONG H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking AMLONG H TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLONG H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How AMLONG H TABLET Works

AMLONG H TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take AMLONG H TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take AMLONG H TABLET at the same time each day. AMLONG H TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take AMLONG H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

name: Amcard AT Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMCARD AT TABLET

AMCARD AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMCARD AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMCARD AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMCARD AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMCARD AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMCARD AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMCARD AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMCARD AT TABLET

AMCARD AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMCARD AT TABLET Works

AMCARD AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
AMCARD AT TABLET can be taken with or without meals.
Your doctor will prescribe the correct dosage and duration based on your health condition.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

Introduction About CILNY 20MG TABLET

CILNY 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNY 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNY 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNY 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNY 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLO 2.5 TABLET

AMLO 2.5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLO 2.5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLO 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLO 2.5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLO 2.5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

introduction:
Introduction About CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET

CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET contains Verapamil which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure), manage chest pain (angina). It is also used to manage certain types of abnormal heartbeats.

CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have heart failure or severe problems with the heart rhythms, recent history of heart attack, slow heart rate, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients who had a heart attack, cardiomyopathy (a disease of the heart muscle), kidney failure, liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is considered clearly necessary and CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET are headache, dizziness, slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, flushing, constipation, nausea, swelling of the limbs. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage certain types of abnormal heartbeats

mechanismOfAction:
How CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET Works

CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET works by blocking the movement of calcium into the cells of the heart and blood vessels. As a result, it relaxes blood vessels which leads to the lowering of high blood pressure. This increases the blood supply and oxygen to the heart while also relaxing the heart muscle. Thus, managing high blood pressure and angina (chest pain) effectively. CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET also interfere with the electrical signals in the heart muscle, useful in managing abnormal heartbeats.
usageDetails:
How to use CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET

Take CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET until your doctor tells you to stop. Otherwise, your condition may get worse.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Alpha or beta-blockers (medicines used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases) Ex. prazosin, doxazosin, metoprolol and propranolol
Aspirin (used for pain fever or to manage blood clots)
Quinidine, flecainide (used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Imipramine, buspirone (used to manage depression, anxiety and panic disorder)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Erythromycin, clarithromycin and telithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir, nelfinavir (medicines used to manage HIV)
Doxorubicin (used in the management of cancer)
Phenobarbital, carbamazepine and phenytoin (used to manage epilepsy)
Digitoxin and digoxin, ivabradine (medicines used in the management of heart failure)
Colchicine, sulfinpyrazone (used to manage gout)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Immunosuppressants Ex. ciclosporin, everolimus, sirolimus and tacrolimus (medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection)
Statins (used to manage high levels of cholesterol) Ex. atorvastatin, lovastatin and simvastatin
Lithium (used to manage mania)
Midazolam (used as a sedative or anaesthetic)
Glibenclamide, glyburide, metformin (used to manage diabetes)
Neuromuscular blocking agents Ex. vecuronium (used in anaesthesia)
Almotriptan (used to manage migraine)
Dabigatran (used to manage blood clot)
St. John’s Wort (used for mild anxiety)
Antihypertensives (medicines used to manage high blood pressure) Ex. chlorothiazide, ramipril
Theophylline (used to manage asthma)
Medicines to manage fungal infections, such as fluconazole or itraconazole

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Do not eat or drink products containing grapefruit juice while taking CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET, as grapefruit juice increases the effects of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose of CALAPTIN 120 SR TABLET are low blood pressure and in rare cases heart failure.

introduction:
Introduction About NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Indapamide, which belong to the group of medicines called Calcium-channel blockers and Thiazide diuretics. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension), which is a condition in which the force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries, which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver or heart. If you are elderly and younger than 18 years old, you should consult with a doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any conditions such as diabetes, low blood pressure, gout, low levels of potassium in the blood (hypokalaemia) and symptoms of fluid accumulation around the eye that present with visual disturbances or eye pain. The most common side effects of taking NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, dizziness and tiredness.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET Works

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle, resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Indapamide reduces blood pressure by promoting the excretion of extra fluid and certain salts (sodium) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET

Always take NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET as instructed by your doctor. Take NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not stop taking the medicine without informing your doctor.

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.
NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET may cause side effects such as dizziness or tiredness due to low blood pressure, so use caution while driving or operating heavy machinery.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET.

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease undergoing dialysis and it is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET.

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in liver disease patients and it is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET.
Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to Amlodipine and Perindopril or other inactive preparations of this medicine.

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET should not be used in patients with heart problems such as heart failure, recent heart attack, narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock (where the heart is unable to pump a sufficient amount of blood to the body).

Others

Do not take NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET, if you have:

Hepatic encephalopathy
Severe low blood pressure

Before taking NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe increase in blood pressure
Diabetes
Gout (joint pain and swelling)
Allergic problems with natural sunlight or UV rays (photosensitivity reactions)
Symptoms of fluid accumulation in the vascular layer of the eye (choroidal effusion) or increase in eye pressure such as eye pain or low eye vision

Use in Pediatrics:

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

NATRILAM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients and the dose may be adjusted according to age and weight. The management should be initiated based on kidney, liver or heart function.

introduction:
Introduction About ESPIN H TABLET

ESPIN H TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with ESPIN H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ESPIN H TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ESPIN H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking ESPIN H TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESPIN H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESPIN H TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ESPIN H TABLET Works

ESPIN H TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ESPIN H TABLET

Take ESPIN H TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ESPIN H TABLET at the same time each day. ESPIN H TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take ESPIN H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ESPIN H TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
ESPIN H TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESPIN H TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ESPIN H TABLET if you are allergic to S(-)Amlodipine or Hydrochlorothiazide.

ESPIN H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ESPIN H TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking ESPIN H TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Are on a low sodium diet
Have diabetes
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have gout (painful joints)
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood

Use in Pediatrics:

ESPIN H TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

ESPIN H TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TORCILIN 10MG TABLET

TORCILIN 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking TORCILIN 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

TORCILIN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking TORCILIN 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking TORCILIN 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How TORCILIN 10MG TABLET Works

TORCILIN 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Do not take TRIOLSAR HS 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TOZAM TABLET

TOZAM TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOZAM TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TOZAM TABLET Works

TOZAM TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan where Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker and losartan belong to angiotensin II receptor blocker they collectively function as a vasodilator. It acts by widening of the blood vessels as a result it enhances the blood flow to all parts of the body easily, thereby causing reduction in blood pressure level.
usageDetails:
How to use TOZAM TABLET

Take TOZAM TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ANGICAM H TABLET

ANGICAM H TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with ANGICAM H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ANGICAM H TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ANGICAM H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking ANGICAM H TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ANGICAM H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How ANGICAM H TABLET Works

ANGICAM H TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take ANGICAM H TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ANGICAM H TABLET at the same time each day. ANGICAM H TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take ANGICAM H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About DILNIP 5 TABLET

DILNIP 5 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking DILNIP 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

DILNIP 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking DILNIP 5 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking DILNIP 5 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How DILNIP 5 TABLET Works

DILNIP 5 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About LOSACAR A TABLET

LOSACAR A TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

Used to manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How LOSACAR A TABLET Works

LOSACAR A TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan where Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker and losartan belong to angiotensin II receptor blocker they collectively function as a vasodilator. It acts by widening of the blood vessels as a result it enhances the blood flow to all parts of the body easily, thereby causing reduction in blood pressure level.

Take LOSACAR A TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET

ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET Works

ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET

Take ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking ANGIZEM 30MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET

AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET Works

AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLOSAFE 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

ESLO 1.25MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESLO 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESLO 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESLO 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESLO 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESLO 1.25MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESLO 1.25MG TABLET Works

ESLO 1.25MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET

AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure), angina, irregular heart rhythm and long-term heart failure.

You can take AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue using the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Do not stop taking it on your own, even if you feel fine, as high blood pressure often shows no symptoms, and discontinuing it may worsen your condition. To enhance the effectiveness of the medication, follow your doctor’s advice and adopt healthy lifestyle habits such as regular exercise, maintaining a healthy weight, and eating a balanced diet.

Avoid taking grapefruit or its juice while taking AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.

Before starting this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney conditions. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine. Also, let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking, especially those used for blood pressure or heart-related issues, to avoid potential interactions.

Common side effects of this medicine include headache, swelling in the ankles, skin rash, slow heart rate, nausea, and depression. It may also cause dizziness, so avoid driving or engaging in activities that require concentration until you understand how it affects you. Additionally, it can increase potassium levels in the blood, so you should avoid potassium-rich foods and supplements unless advised otherwise. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels may be necessary during treatment.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET Works

AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Metoprolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart beat more easily thus lowering the blood pressure.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it.
You can take AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET with or without food, but it’s important to take it at the same time each day to help maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow your doctor’s guidance regarding the appropriate dose and duration based on your condition.
Do not miss doses or discontinue the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel fine, as stopping suddenly can cause your blood pressure to spike.
Regularly check your blood pressure to make sure the medication is working as intended.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it’s almost time for your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and resume your usual dosing schedule.

warnings.details: AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to lack of safety data. While there are limited human studies, animal research has shown potential harmful effects on a developing baby. Your doctor will carefully assess the benefits and possible risks before prescribing this medication to you. Please consult with your doctor for further guidance.
AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not suitable for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience tiredness or dizziness while taking this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.
AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease or failure. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET.

AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver cirrhosis. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET.

Do not take AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Amlodipine or Metoprolol. It should be used with caution in patients with history of allergic reactions such as insect stings, foods or other substances.

AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties or asthma including COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease-causing cough, wheezing or breathlessness, phlegm or increase in chest infections). Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET.

AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure, shock caused by heart problems, heart attack, prinzmetal’s angina (suffering from a tight, painful feeling in the chest in periods of rest). AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with controlled heart failure and slow heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET.
AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above) usually, the management will be initiated with a lower dosage by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET.

Others

AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Blocked blood vessels including blood circulation problems (which may cause your fingers and toes to tingle or turn pale or blue)
Unmanageed phaeochromocytoma
Metabolic acidosis
Low blood pressure
Diabetes is associated with frequent episodes of low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)

Before taking AMLOVAS M 5/25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Diabetes mellitus
Blood vessel disorder
Manageed phaeochromocytoma (high blood pressure due to a tumour near the kidney)
Psoriasis (severe skin rashes)
Myasthenia gravis
Dry eyes
Hypertensive crisis (severe increase in blood pressure)

introduction:
Introduction About DILNIP 20 TABLET

DILNIP 20 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking DILNIP 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

DILNIP 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking DILNIP 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking DILNIP 20 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of DILNIP 20 TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How DILNIP 20 TABLET Works

DILNIP 20 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About ESAM 5MG TABLET

ESAM 5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESAM 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESAM 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESAM 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESAM 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESAM 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESAM 5MG TABLET Works

ESAM 5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

Take ESAM 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of ESAM 5MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXOVAS M 50MG TABLET

NEXOVAS M 50MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking NEXOVAS M 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, or gout as a precaution.

NEXOVAS M 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEXOVAS M 50MG TABLET Works

NEXOVAS M 50MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines, namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Take NEXOVAS M 50MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CINOD 5MG TABLET

CINOD 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CINOD 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CINOD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CINOD 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CINOD 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How CINOD 5MG TABLET Works

CINOD 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET

AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET Works

AMTAS AT 50MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

introduction:
Introduction About CILAGARD 5MG TABLET

CILAGARD 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILAGARD 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILAGARD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILAGARD 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILAGARD 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILAGARD 5MG TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How CILAGARD 5MG TABLET Works

CILAGARD 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageInstructions: Always take this medicine as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily.
Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.
Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NUMLO D 5MG TABLET

NUMLO D 5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with NUMLO D 5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking NUMLO D 5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking NUMLO D 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking NUMLO D 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking NUMLO D 5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)

mechanismOfAction:
How NUMLO D 5MG TABLET Works

NUMLO D 5MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take NUMLO D 5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take NUMLO D 5MG TABLET at the same time each day. NUMLO D 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take NUMLO D 5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET

AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET Works

AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMLOGARD 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.
