sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET

Like all medicines, AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them

Most Common Side Effects of AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET are:
Swelling of ankles, hands and feet
Headache, dizziness
Slow heart rate
Feeling faint on standing due to low blood pressure
Stomach upset
Muscle cramps
Mood changes, anxiety, sleeplessness, depression
Numbness or tingling sensation in your limbs, loss of pain sensation
Low blood pressure
Increased need to urinate at night
Inability to obtain an erection, discomfort or enlargement of the breasts in men
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
Weight increase or decrease

Stop taking AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction (such as itching, difficulty breathing or swelling of the face, lips, throat or tongue)
Wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Severe skin reactions including intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over the whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reaction
Abnormal heartbeat, heart attack
Inflamed pancreas which may cause severe abdominal and back pain accompanied with feeling very unwell

warnings.details: AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women due to lack of safety data. While there are limited human studies, animal research has shown potential harmful effects on a developing baby. Your doctor will carefully assess the benefits and possible risks before prescribing this medication to you. Please consult with your doctor for further guidance.
AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not suitable for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience tiredness or dizziness while taking this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.
AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease or failure. Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET.

AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver cirrhosis. Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET.

Do not take AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Amlodipine or Metoprolol. It should be used with caution in patients with history of allergic reactions such as insect stings, foods or other substances.

AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties or asthma including COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease-causing cough, wheezing or breathlessness, phlegm or increase in chest infections). Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET.

AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure, shock caused by heart problems, heart attack, prinzmetal’s angina (suffering from a tight, painful feeling in the chest in periods of rest). AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with controlled heart failure and slow heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET.
AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Before taking AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET inform your doctor, if you are taking or receiving any of these medicines:

Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice and grapefruit while taking AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET, this is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure-lowering effect of AMLODAC M 25/5MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIPRES N TABLET

CILNIPRES N TABLET is a combination of Nebivolol and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of essential hypertension that occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure, not because of a medical condition.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurry vision, chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, fatigue, mental confusion, nosebleed and severe headaches.

CILNIPRES N TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious kidney problems, lung diseases such as asthma or wheezing, liver function disorders, heart diseases such as heart failure, heart conduction disorders or very slow heartbeat, diabetic ketoacidosis, unmanageed phaeochromocytoma, serious circulation problems and low blood pressure.

CILNIPRES N TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have diabetes, overactive thyroid gland, allergy, peripheral oedema and who are planned for any scheduled surgery which requires anesthesia.  

CILNIPRES N TABLET should not be used by pregnant or breast-feeding women, children and adolescents below 18 years of age. CILNIPRES N TABLET should be used with caution in elderly individuals above 75 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIPRES N TABLET are headache, dizziness, constipation, nausea, diarrhea, shortness of breath and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILNIPRES N TABLET
Manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIPRES N TABLET Works

CILNIPRES N TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where nebivolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by the blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart to beat more easily thus it lowers the blood pressure and cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker which decreases the blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and enhances easy flow of blood to the heart muscles.
usageDetails:
How to use CILNIPRES N TABLET

Take CILNIPRES N TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Espin 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESPIN 5MG TABLET

ESPIN 5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESPIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESPIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESPIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESPIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESPIN 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESPIN 5MG TABLET

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How ESPIN 5MG TABLET Works

ESPIN 5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

Take ESPIN 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of ESPIN 5MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET

LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET Works

LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.

warnings.details: The safety of LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET.
LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
LUPIDIP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

Introduction About CETANIL M 50MG TABLET

CETANIL M 50MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CETANIL M 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, or gout as a precaution.

CETANIL M 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

It is used to:

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain), or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
mechanismOfAction:
How CETANIL M 50MG TABLET Works

CETANIL M 50MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines, namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageDetails:
How to use CETANIL M 50MG TABLET

Take CETANIL M 50MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in the blood)
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)

Are prone to allergic reactions very often (such as even for insect bites)

Are severely dehydrated
Have low sodium, potassium, or magnesium levels in the blood

Have gout
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Have edema (swelling of body parts)

If you or anyone else accidentally took more CETANIL M 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Overdosage may cause low blood pressure, decreased heartbeat, problems breathing, vomiting, feeling faint, and fits.

introduction:
Introduction About CILACAR C TABLET

CILACAR C TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels. Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

CILACAR C TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease and it should be used in caution with patient having diabetes.

CILACAR C TABLET is not intended for use in the pregnant and breast-feeding woman. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

As safety and efficacy in children has not been established, consult your doctor about the risk and benefits before taking CILACAR C TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CILACAR C TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects are not improving.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)

Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How CILACAR C TABLET Works

CILACAR C TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction.

Take CILACAR C TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About AMTAS 10MG TABLET

AMTAS 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMTAS 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMTAS 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMTAS 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMTAS 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMTAS 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMTAS 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

AMTAS 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMTAS 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMTAS 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMTAS 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMTAS 10MG TABLET Works

AMTAS 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMTAS 10MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMTAS 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMTAS 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMTAS 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMTAS 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMTAS 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About TORCILIN 5MG TABLET

TORCILIN 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking TORCILIN 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

TORCILIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking TORCILIN 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking TORCILIN 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:

Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How TORCILIN 5MG TABLET Works

TORCILIN 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.
Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET

S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET Works

S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

Take S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of S NUMLO 2.5MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET

LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET Works

LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your LUPIDIP 10MG TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

Introduction About CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET

CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET contains Verapamil which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure), manage chest pain (angina). It is also used to manage certain types of abnormal heartbeats.

CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have heart failure or severe problems with the heart rhythms, recent history of heart attack, slow heart rate, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who had a heart attack, cardiomyopathy (a disease of the heart muscle), kidney failure, liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is considered clearly necessary and CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, flushing, constipation, nausea, swelling of the limbs. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET Works

CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET works by blocking the movement of calcium into the cells of the heart and blood vessels. As a result, it relaxes blood vessels which leads to the lowering of high blood pressure. This increases the blood supply and oxygen to the heart while also relaxing the heart muscle. Thus, managing high blood pressure and angina (chest pain) effectively. CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET also interfere with the electrical signals in the heart muscle, useful in managing abnormal heartbeats.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CALAPTIN 80MG TABLET until your doctor tells you to stop. Otherwise, your condition may get worse.

name: BETACARD AM Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About BETACARD AM TABLET

BETACARD AM TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take BETACARD AM TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BETACARD AM TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking BETACARD AM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

BETACARD AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking BETACARD AM TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BETACARD AM TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BETACARD AM TABLET

BETACARD AM TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How BETACARD AM TABLET Works

BETACARD AM TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.
usageInstructions: Take BETACARD AM TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
BETACARD AM TABLET can be taken with or without meals.
Your doctor will prescribe the correct dosage and duration based on your health condition.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

warnings.details: BETACARD AM TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
BETACARD AM TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking BETACARD AM TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking BETACARD AM TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
BETACARD AM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
BETACARD AM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take BETACARD AM TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
BETACARD AM TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

BETACARD AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
BETACARD AM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
BETACARD AM TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

BETACARD AM TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking BETACARD AM TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking BETACARD AM TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure and angina (such as nifedipine, verapamil, diltiazem, enalapril, ramipril, metoprolol, clonidine)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection and to suppress immune functions (such as tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everlimus, cyclosporine)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat (Ex. amiodarone, digoxin, quinidine or disopyramide)
Adrenaline (a medicine used to stimulate the heart)
Indomethacin or ibuprofen (medicines used for pain relief)
Medicines used to manage nose or sinus congestion and other cold remedies (such as montelukast, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. insulin, metformin, glimepiride)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BETACARD AM TABLET, as it could lead to further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more BETACARD AM TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin and shortness of breath.

Introduction About CINOD BETA 10/25MG TABLET

CINOD BETA 10/25MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. How CINOD BETA 10/25MG TABLET Works

CINOD BETA 10/25MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AZELIREN 8 TABLET

AZELIREN 8 TABLET contains Azelnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is indicated for the management of stage-I and stage-II hypertension. Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease or stroke.

Stage I hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 130 to 139 mm Hg or a diastolic pressure ranging from 80 to 89 mm Hg. Stage II hypertension has systolic pressure ranging from 140 mm Hg or higher or a diastolic pressure ranging from 90 mm Hg or higher.

Along management with AZELIREN 8 TABLET, your doctor might advise you to follow certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy diet, taking adequate sleep, weight and stress management and avoid smoking or drinking alcohol.    

Before taking AZELIREN 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney diseases or any other medical conditions. Your doctor might ask you to take some blood tests before initiating the management with AZELIREN 8 TABLET to understand the existing condition and for proper use of this medicine.

AZELIREN 8 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who has a possibility to conceive, and breast-feeding women. AZELIREN 8 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.   

Avoid consumption of grapefruit juice while taking AZELIREN 8 TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure. The most common side effects of taking AZELIREN 8 TABLET are dizziness, light-headedness, nausea, constipation, fatigue and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Breastfeeding

NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET.

Alcohol

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Kidney

NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Liver

NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Allergy

Do not take NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to S(-)Amlodipine or Hydrochlorothiazide.

Heart Disease

NUMLO D 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Have low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)

Are on a low sodium diet
Have diabetes
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have gout (painful joints)
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About AMO 10 TABLET

AMO 10 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMO 10 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMO 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMO 10 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMO 10 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMO 10 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMO 10 TABLET in Hypertension:

AMO 10 TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMO 10 TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMO 10 TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMO 10 TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.
mechanismOfAction:
How AMO 10 TABLET Works

AMO 10 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMO 10 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

If you miss a dose of AMO 10 TABLET, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one, as this may lead to side effects or complications.

Symptoms of Overdosage: Overdosing on AMO 10 TABLET may cause symptoms such as dizziness, confusion, muscle pain, or weakness. If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or contact your healthcare provider.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMO 10 TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMO 10 TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMO 10 TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLEOD 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLEOD 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLEOD 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLEOD 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLEOD 5 TABLET Works

AMLEOD 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

AMLEOD 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.

introduction:
Introduction About BENITOWA CH TABLET

BENITOWA CH TABLET is a combination of Benidipine and Chlorthalidone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in the management of hypertension.

Hypertension (high blood pressure) is a common condition in which the long-term force of the blood against artery walls is high enough that it may eventually cause heart disease. Symptoms include headaches, shortness of breath or nosebleeds (if condition is severe).

Along with this management your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating a healthy diet, quitting smoking and alcohol, regular exercise and reducing your weight.

Prior to the management your doctor might take certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

BENITOWA CH TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low blood pressure. Before taking BENITOWA CH TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease.

Safety and effectiveness of BENITOWA CH TABLET in children have not been established yet. Consult your doctor before taking.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking BENITOWA CH TABLET. The most common side effects of taking BENITOWA CH TABLET are glucose intolerance, sleepiness, ankle swelling, headache, and tiredness.
uses: Used to manage high blood pressure
usesDetails:

Used to manage high blood pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How BENITOWA CH TABLET Works

BENITOWA CH TABLET works by lowering the blood pressure. Benidipine relaxes blood vessels and makes the heart more efficient at pumping blood throughout the body. Chlorthalidone reduces the amount of water in the body by increasing the flow of urine, which helps to lower blood pressure.

name: Amlodac D Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLODAC D TABLET

AMLODAC D TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Indapamide, which belong to the group of medicines called Calcium-channel blockers and Thiazide diuretics. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension), which is a condition in which the force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries, which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver or heart. If you are elderly and younger than 18 years old, you should consult with a doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking AMLODAC D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any conditions such as diabetes, low blood pressure, gout, low levels of potassium in the blood (hypokalaemia) and symptoms of fluid accumulation around the eye that present with visual disturbances or eye pain. The most common side effects of taking AMLODAC D TABLET are headache, nausea, dizziness and tiredness.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLODAC D TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLODAC D TABLET Works

AMLODAC D TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle, resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Indapamide reduces blood pressure by promoting the excretion of extra fluid and certain salts (sodium) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use AMLODAC D TABLET

Always take AMLODAC D TABLET as instructed by your doctor. Take AMLODAC D TABLET with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not stop taking the medicine without informing your doctor.
sideEffects: Reduced levels of potassium in the blood
Red raised rashes on the skin

Sudden chest pain, wheezing and trouble breathing
Angioedema or urticaria (such as rash, swelling of the face, lips, mouth, throat or airways which can lead to difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

warnings.details: AMLODAC D TABLET should not be used by pregnant women. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.
AMLODAC D TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.
AMLODAC D TABLET may cause side effects such as dizziness or tiredness due to low blood pressure, so use caution while driving or operating heavy machinery.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with AMLODAC D TABLET.

AMLODAC D TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease undergoing dialysis and it is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking AMLODAC D TABLET.

AMLODAC D TABLET should be used with caution in liver disease patients and it is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking AMLODAC D TABLET.
Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to Amlodipine and Perindopril or other inactive preparations of this medicine.

AMLODAC D TABLET should not be used in patients with heart problems such as heart failure, recent heart attack, narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock (where the heart is unable to pump a sufficient amount of blood to the body).

Others

Do not take AMLODAC D TABLET, if you have:

Hepatic encephalopathy
Severe low blood pressure

Before taking AMLODAC D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe increase in blood pressure
Diabetes
Gout (joint pain and swelling)
Allergic problems with natural sunlight or UV rays (photosensitivity reactions)
Symptoms of fluid accumulation in the vascular layer of the eye (choroidal effusion) or increase in eye pressure such as eye pain or low eye vision

Use in Pediatrics:

AMLODAC D TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMLODAC D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients and the dose may be adjusted according to age and weight. The management should be initiated based on kidney, liver or heart function.

name: Nulong OL 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NULONG OL 20MG TABLET

NULONG OL 20MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Before taking NULONG OL 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

NULONG OL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking NULONG OL 20MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NULONG OL 20MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How NULONG OL 20MG TABLET Works

NULONG OL 20MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan. Olmesartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Cilnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take NULONG OL 20MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET

CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET is a combination of Nebivolol and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of essential hypertension that occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure, not because of a medical condition.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurry vision, chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, fatigue, mental confusion, nosebleed and severe headaches.

CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious kidney problems, lung diseases such as asthma or wheezing, liver function disorders, heart diseases such as heart failure, heart conduction disorders or very slow heartbeat, diabetic ketoacidosis, unmanageed phaeochromocytoma, serious circulation problems and low blood pressure.

CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have diabetes, overactive thyroid gland, allergy, peripheral oedema and who are planned for any scheduled surgery which requires anesthesia.  

CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET should not be used by pregnant or breast-feeding women, children and adolescents below 18 years of age. CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly individuals above 75 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, constipation, nausea, diarrhea, shortness of breath and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET
Manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET Works

CILNIKEM BETA 10/5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where nebivolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by the blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart to beat more easily thus it lowers the blood pressure and cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker which decreases the blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and enhances easy flow of blood to the heart muscles.

Introduction About CHANNEL SR 120 TABLET

CHANNEL SR 120 TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with CHANNEL SR 120 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CHANNEL SR 120 TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking CHANNEL SR 120 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

CHANNEL SR 120 TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking CHANNEL SR 120 TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About AMCARD 5MG TABLET

AMCARD 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMCARD 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMCARD 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMCARD 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMCARD 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMCARD 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMCARD 5MG TABLET Works

AMCARD 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMCARD 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of AMCARD 5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMCARD 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMCARD 5MG TABLET.
AMCARD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMCARD 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMCARD 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMCARD 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMCARD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About CILDIP 5MG TABLET

CILDIP 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILDIP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILDIP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILDIP 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILDIP 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
