How CILDIP 5MG TABLET Works

CILDIP 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLONG A 50MG TABLET

AMLONG A 50MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLONG A 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLONG A 50MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLONG A 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLONG A 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLONG A 50MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLONG A 50MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How AMLONG A 50MG TABLET Works

AMLONG A 50MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

introduction:
Introduction About AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET

AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET Works

AMTAS AT 25MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

introduction:
Introduction About CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET

CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET Works

CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

warnings.details: The safety of CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET.
CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
CORVADIL 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

Introduction About CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET

CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevent heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)

mechanismOfAction:
How CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET Works

CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageDetails:
How to use CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET

Take CILACAR M 10/50MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Are in shock caused due to poor blood circulation

Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)

Have gout

Have edema (swelling of body parts)

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOKIND H TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLOKIND H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Before taking CILAPRESS 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

The most common side effects of taking CILAPRESS 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How CILAPRESS 10 TABLET Works

CILAPRESS 10 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. introduction:
Introduction About AMLODAC AT TABLET

AMLODAC AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLODAC AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLODAC AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLODAC AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLODAC AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLODAC AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLODAC AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLODAC AT TABLET

AMLODAC AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLODAC AT TABLET Works

AMLODAC AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

AMLODAC AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMLODAC AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
AMLODAC AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMLODAC AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking AMLODAC AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

introduction:
Introduction About REVAS AM 5MG TABLET

REVAS AM 5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:
Uses Of REVAS AM 5MG TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How REVAS AM 5MG TABLET Works

REVAS AM 5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan where Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker and losartan belong to angiotensin II receptor blocker they collectively function as a vasodilator. It acts by widening of the blood vessels as a result it enhances the blood flow to all parts of the body easily, thereby causing reduction in blood pressure level.

Take REVAS AM 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ANGICAM 5MG TABLET

ANGICAM 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take ANGICAM 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking ANGICAM 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of ANGICAM 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking ANGICAM 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANGICAM 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How ANGICAM 5MG TABLET Works

ANGICAM 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

When to consult your doctor?

warnings.details: The safety of ANGICAM 5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ANGICAM 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking ANGICAM 5MG TABLET.
ANGICAM 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take ANGICAM 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

ANGICAM 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
ANGICAM 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
ANGICAM 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

name: BENISURE 8 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BENISURE 8 TABLET

BENISURE 8 TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENISURE 8 TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENISURE 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENISURE 8 TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENISURE 8 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking BENISURE 8 TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How BENISURE 8 TABLET Works

BENISURE 8 TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

Do not stop taking BENISURE 8 TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Introduction About DILTICON SR 90 TABLET

DILTICON SR 90 TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

During management with DILTICON SR 90 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILTICON SR 90 TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILTICON SR 90 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILTICON SR 90 TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILTICON SR 90 TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How DILTICON SR 90 TABLET Works

DILTICON SR 90 TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMY A 40MG TABLET

OLMY A 40MG TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMY A 40MG TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMY A 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMY A 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLMY A 40MG TABLET Works

OLMY A 40MG TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medicine, as it could aggravate your dizziness and tiredness.

OLMY A 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function are required in such patients.

OLMY A 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Diabetes-related kidney problems
Severe hypotension (very low blood pressure)

Have severe vomiting and/or diarrhea
Are on a low-sodium diet
Have hyperkalemia (increased levels of potassium in the blood)
Have problems with the adrenal glands

Introduction About CINOD 20 TABLET

CINOD 20 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CINOD 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CINOD 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CINOD 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CINOD 20 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNISKY 10 TABLET

CILNISKY 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNISKY 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNISKY 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNISKY 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNISKY 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:

Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNISKY 10 TABLET Works

CILNISKY 10 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.

Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET Works

AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
AMLOPRES AT 50MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals.
Your doctor will prescribe the correct dosage and duration based on your health condition.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

introduction:
Introduction About ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET

ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

Take ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Prevents heart attack
mechanismOfAction:
How ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET Works

ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET contains two medicines namely S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Take ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ASOMEX AT 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Introduction About TWINCAL 20MG TABLET

TWINCAL 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking TWINCAL 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

TWINCAL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking TWINCAL 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking TWINCAL 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About WELLAMO 5 TABLET

WELLAMO 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take WELLAMO 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking WELLAMO 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of WELLAMO 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking WELLAMO 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How WELLAMO 5 TABLET Works

WELLAMO 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take WELLAMO 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking WELLAMO 5 TABLET.
WELLAMO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.

WELLAMO 5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. WELLAMO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About TWINCAL 5MG TABLET

TWINCAL 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking TWINCAL 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

TWINCAL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking TWINCAL 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking TWINCAL 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How TWINCAL 5MG TABLET Works

TWINCAL 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLEOD H TABLET

AMLEOD H TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with AMLEOD H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLEOD H TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLEOD H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking AMLEOD H TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLEOD H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLEOD H TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLEOD H TABLET Works

AMLEOD H TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use AMLEOD H TABLET

Take AMLEOD H TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take AMLEOD H TABLET at the same time each day. AMLEOD H TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take AMLEOD H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE

DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE Works

DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE

Take DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DILZEM CD 180MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CTD C 12.5/10MG TABLET

CTD C 12.5/10MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels. Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

CTD C 12.5/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease and it should be used in caution with patient having diabetes.

CTD C 12.5/10MG TABLET is not intended for use in the pregnant and breast-feeding woman. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

As safety and efficacy in children has not been established, consult your doctor about the risk and benefits before taking CTD C 12.5/10MG TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CTD C 12.5/10MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects are not improving.

mechanismOfAction:

CTD C 12.5/10MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNEP 5 TABLET

CILNEP 5 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNEP 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNEP 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNEP 5 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNEP 5 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNEP 5 TABLET Works

CILNEP 5 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.
Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

name: Amlosafe MT 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage (hypertension). It is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high which is characterized by symptoms such as headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety and chest pain.

During management with AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET practice regular exercise (such as walking), eating healthy and salt-restricted diet and managing weight will also help to control your blood pressure effectively. Avoid taking grapefruit or its juice while taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure lowering effect of this medicine.

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lungs problems (such as asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease), kidney disease or failure, liver disease, heart problems (such as heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure), metabolic acidosis and low blood pressure.

Before taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have controlled heart failure and slow heart rate, diabetes mellitus, blood vessel disorder, psoriasis (severe skin rashes), myasthenia gravis and hypertensive crisis (severe increase in blood pressure).

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, nausea, slow heart rate or stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET
 Manages High Blood Pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET Works

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Metoprolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by the blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart to beat more easily thus it lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET

Take AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience tiredness or dizziness while taking this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure lowering effect of this medicine.
AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease or failure. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET.

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver cirrhosis. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET.

Do not take AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Amlodipine or Metoprolol. It should be used with caution in patients with history of allergic reactions such as insect stings, foods or other substances.

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties or asthma including COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease causing cough, wheezing or breathlessness, phlegm or increase in chest infections). Consult your doctor before taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET.

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure, shock caused by heart problems, heart attack, prinzmetal’s angina (suffer from a tight, painful feeling in the chest in periods of rest). AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with controlled heart failure and slow heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET.

Others

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Blocked blood vessels including blood circulation problems (which may cause your fingers and toes to tingle or turn pale or blue)
Unmanageed phaeochromocytoma
Metabolic acidosis
Low blood pressure
Diabetes associated with frequent episodes of low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)

Before taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Diabetes mellitus
Blood vessel disorder
Manageed phaeochromocytoma (high blood pressure due to tumour near the kidney)
Psoriasis (severe skin rashes)
Myasthenia gravis
Dry eyes
Hypertensive crisis (severe increase in blood pressure)

Use in Pediatrics:

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above), usually the management will be initiated with a lower dosage by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOSAFE MT 50MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET

CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:

Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET Works

CILNIKEM 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Introduction About CILAMET XL 10/50 TABLET

CILAMET XL 10/50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CILAMET XL 10/50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, or gout as a precaution.

CILAMET XL 10/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How CILAMET XL 10/50 TABLET Works

CILAMET XL 10/50 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines, namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

name: AMLEOD 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About AMLEOD 10 TABLET

AMLEOD 10 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLEOD 10 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLEOD 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLEOD 10 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLEOD 10 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
Benefits of AMLEOD 10 TABLET in Hypertension:

AMLEOD 10 TABLET works by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps to reduce blood pressure. It improves overall circulation, making it easier for the heart to pump blood, thus effectively managing high blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

Benefits of AMLEOD 10 TABLET in Angina:

By improving blood flow and reducing cholesterol plaque build-up in arteries, AMLEOD 10 TABLET helps reduce angina (heart-related chest pain) caused by blocked or narrowed coronary arteries. This reduces the frequency and intensity of chest pain episodes, allowing for improved quality of life for patients with heart disease.

 

Other Benefits:

By controlling blood pressure, AMLEOD 10 TABLET helps reduce the chances of heart attacks, strokes, and other serious cardiovascular events in patients suffering from hypertension and angina.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir)

Effect: These medications can increase the blood levels of Amlodipine, leading to a higher risk of side effects like severe low blood pressure (hypotension), dizziness, or swelling in the ankles and feet.

2. Nitrates (e.g., Nitroglycerin, Isosorbide Dinitrate)

Effect: Combining Amlodipine with nitrates can result in severe hypotension (low blood pressure), causing dizziness, fainting, or even shock, especially when used in patients with heart disease.

3. Alpha-blockers (e.g., Doxazosin, Prazosin)

Effect: When used together, Amlodipine can intensify the blood pressure-lowering effects of alpha-blockers, leading to excessive hypotension and an increased risk of dizziness or fainting, particularly when standing up.

Other drug-drug interactions are:

Antibiotics (Ex. rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin)
St. John’s Wort (Ex. hypericum perforatum)
Heart medicines (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Skeletal muscle relaxant (Ex. Dantrolene)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, ciclosporin)
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (Ex. Simvastatin)
B. Drug-Food interactions:

Grapefruit juice and grapefruit is not recommended while taking the medicine. This is because grapefruit and grapefruit juice can lead to an increase in the blood levels of the active ingredient amlodipine, which can cause an unpredictable increase in the blood pressure lowering effect of the medicine.
moreInfo:
More Information

When taking AMLEOD 10 TABLET for managing high blood pressure (hypertension) or angina (chest pain), combining it with healthy lifestyle choices and a balanced diet can significantly enhance the medication's effectiveness. Here are some expert tips:

1. Follow a Heart-Healthy Diet:

Limit Salt Intake: Reduce your sodium intake to help manage blood pressure. Aim for less than 2,300 mg of sodium per day, or lower if advised by your doctor.
Increase Fruits and Vegetables: Include plenty of potassium-rich foods like bananas, oranges, leafy greens, and sweet potatoes to help regulate blood pressure.
Opt for Whole Grains: Choose whole grains like oats, brown rice, and whole wheat bread instead of refined grains to improve heart health and control cholesterol levels.
Healthy Fats: Focus on unsaturated fats (found in olive oil, nuts, and avocados) and avoid trans fats and excessive saturated fats that can increase cholesterol.

2. Maintain a Healthy Weight:

Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (like walking or cycling) most days of the week. Regular physical activity helps reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and maintain a healthy weight.
Weight Management: If you are overweight, losing even a small amount of weight can significantly help in lowering blood pressure and improving heart health.

3. Limit Alcohol and Quit Smoking

Limit Alcohol Consumption: Drinking alcohol in excess can increase blood pressure and reduce the effectiveness of medications like AMLEOD 10 TABLET. Stick to the recommended limits: up to one drink per day for women and two drinks per day for men.
Quit Smoking: Smoking can increase the risk of heart disease and complications associated with hypertension. Quitting smoking improves overall heart health and reduces blood pressure.

4. Monitor Your Blood Pressure Regularly

Keep track of your blood pressure readings at home to ensure that your AMLEOD 10 TABLET dosage is working effectively. Regular monitoring can help adjust treatment if needed.

5. Manage Stress

Chronic stress can contribute to high blood pressure and heart-related issues. Incorporate stress-reducing techniques like yoga, meditation, or deep breathing exercises into your daily routine to help manage blood pressure.

6. Stay Hydrated

Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps regulate blood pressure and supports overall cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About INZIT 4MG TABLET

INZIT 4MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

INZIT 4MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking INZIT 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking INZIT 4MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking INZIT 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking INZIT 4MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET Works

ESAMLOVIN 5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

Introduction About AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET

AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET Works

AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.
usageDetails:
How to use AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET

Take AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET.
AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, headache, fatigue (extreme tiredness), impaired ability to react or nausea after taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET.
AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET.
AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET.
AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to dihydropyridine derivatives (such as felodipine, nimodipine), S-Amlodipine, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure), shock including cardiogenic shock (serious condition caused by the sudden drop in blood flow through the body, high grade aortic stenosis (obstruction of the outflow tract of the left ventricle), or haemodynamically unstable heart failure after heart attack. AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET.
Safety and effectiveness of AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET is not established in children. Consult child’s doctor for advice.
AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage certain viral infections (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, miconazole)
Certain medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin, rifampicin)
Certain medicines used to lower blood pressure (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Dantrolene infusion (used to manage muscle stiffness)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection (Ex. tacrolimus, cyclosporine)
Simvastatin (used to reduce blood cholesterol)
St. john's wort (used to manage depression)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET as it may drop your blood pressure further. 

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of AMLOBACT S 2.5 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The common symptoms of overdose are low blood pressure and fast heartbeat.
