name: ISDIL 60MG TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ISDIL 60MG TABLET

ISDIL 60MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with ISDIL 60MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

ISDIL 60MG TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISDIL 60MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ISDIL 60MG TABLET Works

ISDIL 60MG TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ISDIL 60MG TABLET

Take ISDIL 60MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

warnings.details: ISDIL 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and in women who think that they might be pregnant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ISDIL 60MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. However, consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or tiredness after taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
ISDIL 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ISDIL 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ISDIL 60MG TABLET if you are allergic to Diltiazem.
ISDIL 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a previous history of asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ISDIL 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious heart problems (such as having a very slow or uneven heartbeat or heart failure). It should be used with caution in patients with a previous history of heart failure, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or low blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ISDIL 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have problems in blood circulation especially to the lungs

Before taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have any surgery in the upcoming days
Have depression
Have any mental illness that causes mood changes
Have any stomach problems
Have diabetes
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Use in Pediatrics:

ISDIL 60MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

ISDIL 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

B. Drug-Food Interactions:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking ISDIL 60MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more ISDIL 60MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include severe hypotension (low blood pressure) leading to dizziness, fainting, slow heartbeat and changes in heart rhythm.

name: Amlovin H Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVIN H TABLET

AMLOVIN H TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with AMLOVIN H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOVIN H TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLOVIN H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVIN H TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVIN H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOVIN H TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVIN H TABLET Works

AMLOVIN H TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use AMLOVIN H TABLET

Take AMLOVIN H TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take AMLOVIN H TABLET at the same time each day. AMLOVIN H TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take AMLOVIN H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

warnings.details: AMLOVIN H TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMLOVIN H TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking AMLOVIN H TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMLOVIN H TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
AMLOVIN H TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMLOVIN H TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AMLOVIN H TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or Hydrochlorothiazide.

AMLOVIN H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMLOVIN H TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking AMLOVIN H TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Are on a low sodium diet
Have diabetes
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have gout (painful joints)
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood

Use in Pediatrics:

AMLOVIN H TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMLOVIN H TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NULONG 20 TABLET

NULONG 20 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking NULONG 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

NULONG 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking NULONG 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking NULONG 20 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How NULONG 20 TABLET Works

NULONG 20 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET

AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure), angina, irregular heart rhythm and long-term heart failure.

You can take AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue using the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Do not stop taking it on your own, even if you feel fine, as high blood pressure often shows no symptoms, and discontinuing it may worsen your condition. To enhance the effectiveness of the medication, follow your doctor’s advice and adopt healthy lifestyle habits such as regular exercise, maintaining a healthy weight, and eating a balanced diet.

Avoid taking grapefruit or its juice while taking AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.

Before starting this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney conditions. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using this medicine. Also, let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking, especially those used for blood pressure or heart-related issues, to avoid potential interactions.

Common side effects of this medicine include headache, swelling in the ankles, skin rash, slow heart rate, nausea, and depression. It may also cause dizziness, so avoid driving or engaging in activities that require concentration until you understand how it affects you. Additionally, it can increase potassium levels in the blood, so you should avoid potassium-rich foods and supplements unless advised otherwise. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels may be necessary during treatment.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET Works

AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by inhibiting the movement of calcium ions into both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle resulting in lower blood pressure by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles. Metoprolol works by reducing the force of contraction of the heart muscles by blocking the effects of certain hormones called adrenaline and making the heart beat more easily thus lowering the blood pressure.

Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it.
You can take AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET with or without food, but it’s important to take it at the same time each day to help maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body.
Follow your doctor’s guidance regarding the appropriate dose and duration based on your condition.
Do not miss doses or discontinue the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel fine, as stopping suddenly can cause your blood pressure to spike.
Regularly check your blood pressure to make sure the medication is working as intended.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it’s almost time for your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and resume your usual dosing schedule.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET as it may increase the blood pressure-lowering effect of this medicine.
AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease or failure. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET.

AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver cirrhosis. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET.

Do not take AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Amlodipine or Metoprolol. It should be used with caution in patients with history of allergic reactions such as insect stings, foods or other substances.

AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties or asthma including COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease-causing cough, wheezing or breathlessness, phlegm or increase in chest infections). Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET.

AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart conduction or rhythm problems, severe or uncontrolled heart failure, shock caused by heart problems, heart attack, prinzmetal’s angina (suffering from a tight, painful feeling in the chest in periods of rest). AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with controlled heart failure and slow heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET.
AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above) usually, the management will be initiated with a lower dosage by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking AMLOPIN M 25MG TABLET.

Blocked blood vessels including blood circulation problems (which may cause your fingers and toes to tingle or turn pale or blue)

Metabolic acidosis

Diabetes is associated with frequent episodes of low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET

CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET Works

CILNIKEM 20MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET

BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

Do not stop taking BENIBUZ 4MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About NICARDIA CD RETARD 30MG TABLET

NICARDIA CD RETARD 30MG TABLET contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

NICARDIA CD RETARD 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

NICARDIA CD RETARD 30MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking NICARDIA CD RETARD 30MG TABLET are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:

Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NICARDIA CD RETARD 30MG TABLET Works

NICARDIA CD RETARD 30MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

name: Tenolol AM 25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET

TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET

TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)

mechanismOfAction:
How TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET Works

TENOLOL AM 25MG TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

name: N LOK 10mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About N LOK 10MG TABLET

N LOK 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking N LOK 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

N LOK 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking N LOK 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking N LOK 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of N LOK 10MG TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How N LOK 10MG TABLET Works

N LOK 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

name: BENISTO 4 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BENISTO 4 TABLET

BENISTO 4 TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENISTO 4 TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENISTO 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENISTO 4 TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENISTO 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENISTO 4 TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Manage and manages chest pain associated with angina pectoris

mechanismOfAction:
How BENISTO 4 TABLET Works

BENISTO 4 TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

Take BENISTO 4 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take BENISTO 4 TABLET preferably after meals. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking BENISTO 4 TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

name: LN Met 10/50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LN MET 10/50MG TABLET

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking LN MET 10/50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevent heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
usesDetails:
Uses Of LN MET 10/50MG TABLET

It is used to:

Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevent heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
mechanismOfAction:
How LN MET 10/50MG TABLET Works

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageDetails:
How to use LN MET 10/50MG TABLET

Take LN MET 10/50MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart block, uncontrollable heart failure, sick sinus syndrome or a very slow or uneven heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as a recent heart attack, or angina attack, enlarged heart muscles, or surgery in the heart within the last 4 months). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are in shock caused due to poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused due to blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)

Before taking LN MET 10/50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are prone to allergic reactions very often (such as even for insect bites)
Have problems in blood circulation around the body (especially in fingers, arms and feet)
Have diabetes
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased thyroid hormones in the body)
Are severely dehydrated
Have low sodium, potassium, or magnesium levels in the blood
Are going to undergo an operation
Have gout
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Have edema (swelling of body parts)

Use in pediatrics:

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

LN MET 10/50MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

name: BENISURE 4 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BENISURE 4 TABLET

BENISURE 4 TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENISURE 4 TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENISURE 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENISURE 4 TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENISURE 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENISURE 4 TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Manage and manages chest pain associated with angina pectoris

As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

introduction:
Introduction About LN MET 10/25MG TABLET

LN MET 10/25MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking LN MET 10/25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

LN MET 10/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevent heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
usesDetails:
Uses Of LN MET 10/25MG TABLET

It is used to:

Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevent heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
mechanismOfAction:
How LN MET 10/25MG TABLET Works

LN MET 10/25MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageDetails:
How to use LN MET 10/25MG TABLET

Take LN MET 10/25MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Others

Are in shock caused due to poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused due to blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)

Have diabetes
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased thyroid hormones in the body)
Are severely dehydrated
Have low sodium, potassium, or magnesium levels in the blood
Are going to undergo an operation
Have gout
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Have edema (swelling of body parts)

LN MET 10/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

LN MET 10/25MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVAS LS TABLET

AMLOVAS LS TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

Used to manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVAS LS TABLET Works

AMLOVAS LS TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan where Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker and losartan belong to angiotensin II receptor blocker they collectively function as a vasodilator. It acts by widening of the blood vessels as a result it enhances the blood flow to all parts of the body easily, thereby causing reduction in blood pressure level.

Introduction About AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET

AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET Works

AMLOPRIDE S 2.5 TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

introduction:
Introduction About NEPIN + SR 20 TABLET

NEPIN + SR 20 TABLET is a prescription medication primarily used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and other cardiovascular conditions. It belongs to a class of drugs called calcium channel blockers that help relax and widen blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

NEPIN + SR 20 TABLET may be prescribed either on its own or in combination with other medications. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dosage and frequency based on your condition, ensuring you receive the correct amount to manage your condition. The dosage may be adjusted by your doctor depending on your response to the medication and your blood pressure levels. You can take the medication at any time of day, with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time every day. Ensure you take it as soon as you remove it from the package, as it is sensitive to light and may lose its effectiveness if left outside the pack for too long.

Continue taking this medication for the full duration recommended by your doctor, even if you feel fine. Do not stop it on your own, as high blood pressure often shows no symptoms, and discontinuing the medicine could worsen your condition. Staying active through regular exercise, losing weight, and maintaining a healthy diet will also assist in managing your blood pressure. Always follow your doctor's guidance while using this medication.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, headaches, swelling of the ankles, fatigue, unusual heartbeat (palpitations), flushing and constipation. If any of these symptom’s trouble you or persist, consult your doctor.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for guidance before taking it. Also, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are using, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Limit alcohol consumption while on this medication, as it may lower your blood pressure and cause dizziness or lightheadedness. It is important to have your blood pressure monitored regularly to ensure the medication is working effectively.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEPIN + SR 20 TABLET Works

NEPIN + SR 20 TABLET containing nifedipine that works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels, which helps to improve blood flow. It is a calcium channel blocker that inhibits the entry of calcium into the smooth muscle cells of the heart and blood vessel walls. This reduces the contraction of the blood vessels, lowering blood pressure and improving oxygen supply to the heart. NEPIN + SR 20 TABLET is commonly used to manage conditions like hypertension (high blood pressure) and angina (chest pain). By reducing the strain on the heart, it helps to reduce complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

introduction:
Introduction About ZILOS AM TABLET

ZILOS AM TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

How ZILOS AM TABLET Works

It acts by widening of the blood vessels as a result it enhances the blood flow to all parts of the body easily, thereby causing reduction in blood pressure level.

introduction:
Introduction About AMTAS HT TABLET

AMTAS HT TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with AMTAS HT TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMTAS HT TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMTAS HT TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking AMTAS HT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMTAS HT TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMTAS HT TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMTAS HT TABLET Works

AMTAS HT TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use AMTAS HT TABLET

Take AMTAS HT TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take AMTAS HT TABLET at the same time each day. AMTAS HT TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take AMTAS HT TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

AMTAS HT TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking AMTAS HT TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMTAS HT TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
AMTAS HT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMTAS HT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AMTAS HT TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or Hydrochlorothiazide.

AMTAS HT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMTAS HT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking AMTAS HT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Are on a low sodium diet
Have diabetes
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have gout (painful joints)
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood

Use in Pediatrics:

AMTAS HT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMTAS HT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NULONG 5 TABLET

NULONG 5 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking NULONG 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

NULONG 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking NULONG 5 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking NULONG 5 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How NULONG 5 TABLET Works

As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET

NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.
usageDetails:
How to use NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET

Take NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients having poor cardiac reserve (the heart cannot cope with increased strain). Consult with your doctor.

Inflammation of the bowel or intestines, such as Crohn’s disease
Obstruction or narrowing of intestines
Obstruction in the oesophagus (the tube connecting the throat to the stomach)
Kock pouch (a surgically constructed intestinal reservoir with an opening through the abdominal wall) in your gut
Malignant hypertension (continuous rise in blood pressure despite management)

Low blood pressure
Diabetic

NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking NEFISTAR RETARD 30 TABLET.

Overdosage:

name: ISDIL 30MG TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ISDIL 30MG TABLET

ISDIL 30MG TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with ISDIL 30MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ISDIL 30MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ISDIL 30MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

ISDIL 30MG TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking ISDIL 30MG TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISDIL 30MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ISDIL 30MG TABLET Works

ISDIL 30MG TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ISDIL 30MG TABLET

Take ISDIL 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking ISDIL 30MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNEP CH TABLET

CILNEP CH TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels. Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

CILNEP CH TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease and it should be used in caution with patient having diabetes.

CILNEP CH TABLET is not intended for use in the pregnant and breast-feeding woman. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

As safety and efficacy in children has not been established, consult your doctor about the risk and benefits before taking CILNEP CH TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CILNEP CH TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects are not improving.

How CILNEP CH TABLET Works

CILNEP CH TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction.

Take CILNEP CH TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNITAB 5MG TABLET

CILNITAB 5MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNITAB 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNITAB 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNITAB 5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNITAB 5MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNITAB 5MG TABLET Works

CILNITAB 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

name: Amtas LP Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMTAS LP TABLET

AMTAS LP TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking AMTAS LP TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking AMTAS LP TABLET as a precaution.

AMTAS LP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking AMTAS LP TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Manage hypertension and angina

mechanismOfAction:
How AMTAS LP TABLET Works

AMTAS LP TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs (such as kidneys). This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart.

It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It can improve blood supply to the kidneys which helps in improving kidney functions among diabetic patients. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves the functions of the heart and the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use AMTAS LP TABLET

Take AMTAS LP TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. AMTAS LP TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take AMTAS LP TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with AMTAS LP TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
AMTAS LP TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking AMTAS LP TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMTAS LP TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

AMTAS LP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis or narrowing or renal arteries). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMTAS LP TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AMTAS LP TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Lisinopril or to any other calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, enalapril).

AMTAS LP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMTAS LP TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking AMTAS LP TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have low WBC, RBC and platelet count in the blood
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)
Have high blood potassium levels
Previously had stroke or mini stroke

Use in Paediatrics:

AMTAS LP TABLET can be used in children and adolescents (aged between 6-18 years) if prescribed by a physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years. Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMTAS LP TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

name: CALAPTIN 240 SR Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET contains Verapamil which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure), manage chest pain (angina). It is also used to manage certain types of abnormal heartbeats.

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have heart failure or severe problems with the heart rhythms, recent history of heart attack, slow heart rate, low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients who had a heart attack, cardiomyopathy (a disease of the heart muscle), kidney failure, liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is considered clearly necessary and CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET are headache, dizziness, slow heartbeat, low blood pressure, flushing, constipation, nausea, swelling of the limbs. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage certain types of abnormal heartbeats
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET
To manage hypertension
To manage chest pain
To manage certain types of abnormal heartbeats
mechanismOfAction:
How CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET Works

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET works by blocking the movement of calcium into the cells of the heart and blood vessels. As a result, it relaxes blood vessels which leads to the lowering of high blood pressure. This increases the blood supply and oxygen to the heart while also relaxing the heart muscle. Thus, managing high blood pressure and angina (chest pain) effectively. CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET also interfere with the electrical signals in the heart muscle, useful in managing abnormal heartbeats.
usageDetails:
How to use CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET

Take CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET until your doctor tells you to stop. Otherwise, your condition may get worse.

Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Have Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome (rapid heart rate associated with dizziness or faintness)

Before taking CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are having an operation
Have neuromuscular diseases or conditions which cause muscle weakness such as myasthenia gravis, Lambert-Eaton syndrome or advanced Duchenne muscular dystrophy
Have an intolerance to lactose or sucrose

Use in paediatrics:

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET should be used with caution in children. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients with heart or liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Alpha or beta-blockers (medicines used to manage high blood pressure and heart diseases) Ex. prazosin, doxazosin, metoprolol and propranolol
Aspirin (used for pain fever or to manage blood clots)
Quinidine, flecainide (used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Imipramine, buspirone (used to manage depression, anxiety and panic disorder)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Erythromycin, clarithromycin and telithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir, nelfinavir (medicines used to manage HIV)
Doxorubicin (used in the management of cancer)
Phenobarbital, carbamazepine and phenytoin (used to manage epilepsy)
Digitoxin and digoxin, ivabradine (medicines used in the management of heart failure)
Colchicine, sulfinpyrazone (used to manage gout)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Immunosuppressants Ex. ciclosporin, everolimus, sirolimus and tacrolimus (medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection)
Statins (used to manage high levels of cholesterol) Ex. atorvastatin, lovastatin and simvastatin
Lithium (used to manage mania)
Midazolam (used as a sedative or anaesthetic)
Glibenclamide, glyburide, metformin (used to manage diabetes)
Neuromuscular blocking agents Ex. vecuronium (used in anaesthesia)

Dabigatran (used to manage blood clot)

Medicines to manage fungal infections, such as fluconazole or itraconazole

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Do not eat or drink products containing grapefruit juice while taking CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET, as grapefruit juice increases the effects of this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose of CALAPTIN 240 SR TABLET are low blood pressure and in rare cases heart failure.

introduction:
Introduction About CILORY 5 TABLET

CILORY 5 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILORY 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILORY 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILORY 5 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILORY 5 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILORY 5 TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How CILORY 5 TABLET Works

CILORY 5 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About CILORY M 10/50 TABLET

CILORY M 10/50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CILORY M 10/50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

CILORY M 10/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevent heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) or arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)

mechanismOfAction:
How CILORY M 10/50 TABLET Works

CILORY M 10/50 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageDetails:

Take CILORY M 10/50 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.
