introduction:
Introduction About ESPIN LT TABLET

ESPIN LT TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Losartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

It also helps in reducing the risk of heart attack, heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and diabetes.

During management with ESPIN LT TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ESPIN LT TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ESPIN LT TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

ESPIN LT TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby and nursing infants. Stop taking ESPIN LT TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking ESPIN LT TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

ESPIN LT TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. This improves blood supply to the vital organs of the body (such as heart, brain or kidneys). As a result, it reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly across blood vessels with less pressure. It also protects kidney functions and reduces the risk of kidney damage among diabetic patients.

Take ESPIN LT TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ESPIN LT TABLET at the same time each day. ESPIN LT TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take ESPIN LT TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About DILZEM INJECTION

DILZEM INJECTION contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage certain forms of arrhythmia (such as atrial fibrillation and paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT)).

Arrhythmia can be defined as an irregular heartbeat caused due to abnormal electrical signals in the heart. Atrial fibrillation (or atrial flutter) is an irregular or fast heartbeat caused due to improper electrical signals from the upper chambers of the heart (atrium), while PSVT is a fast heartbeat caused due to improper electrical signals from the regions slightly above the ventricles. Symptoms of arrhythmia includes palpitations (racing heartbeat), weakness, fatigue, dizziness and chest pain.

During management with DILZEM INJECTION, your doctor will constantly monitor your heartbeat and blood pressure to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before receiving DILZEM INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from arrhythmia. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or cardiogenic shock as a precaution.

DILZEM INJECTION is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, heart block, or certain other forms of arrhythmia (such as Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome) or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of receiving DILZEM INJECTION are low blood pressure, injection site reaction (Ex. itching, burning sensation) and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DILZEM INJECTION
Manage arrhythmia (atrial fibrillation and PSVT)
mechanismOfAction:
How DILZEM INJECTION Works

DILZEM INJECTION is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels supplying the heart. It also decreases oxygen demand in the heart, reduces the strain on the heart and decreases heart rate.
usageDetails:
How to use DILZEM INJECTION

DILZEM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE

NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE Works

NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

Take NICARDIA 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About C UDP 20MG TABLET

C UDP 20MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking C UDP 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

C UDP 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking C UDP 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking C UDP 20MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders

Uses Of C UDP 20MG TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How C UDP 20MG TABLET Works

C UDP 20MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.
usageInstructions: Always take this medicine as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily.
Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels.
Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

warnings.details: C UDP 20MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
C UDP 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking C UDP 20MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking C UDP 20MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
C UDP 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
C UDP 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take C UDP 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to Cilnidipine.

C UDP 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure or aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries). It should be used with caution in patients with angina or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
C UDP 20MG TABLET should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.
C UDP 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking C UDP 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Edema (swelling of body parts)

name: Amloz 5mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLOZ 5MG TABLET

AMLOZ 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOZ 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOZ 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOZ 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOZ 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOZ 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOZ 5MG TABLET Works

AMLOZ 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOZ 5MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AMLOZ 5MG TABLET

Like all medicines, AMLOZ 5MG TABLET may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of AMLOZ 5MG TABLET:
Swelling of ankles
Headache, dizziness
Sleepiness, tiredness, muscle cramps
Palpitations (awareness of heart beat)
Flushing
Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, indigestion
Nausea
Altered bowel habits
Visual disturbances, double vision
Vomiting
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of AMLOZ 5MG TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMLOZ 5MG TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLOZ 5MG TABLET.
AMLOZ 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLOZ 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLOZ 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLOZ 5MG TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLOZ 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

name: Amlovin H 2.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET

AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. It can also be used to manage the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain).

During management with AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension (such as heart failure) or have diabetes, severe low blood pressure or dehydration or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents the risk of heart attack, stroke or angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET Works

AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET

Take AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET at the same time each day. AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

warnings.details: AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or Hydrochlorothiazide.

AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Are on a low sodium diet
Have diabetes
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have gout (painful joints)
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood

Use in Pediatrics:

AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure or angina (Ex. diltiazem, verapamil)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection and to suppress immune functions (such as tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everlimus, cyclosporine)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicines that can depress the brain such as barbiturates (Ex. phenobarbital)
Narcotic drugs (used for pain relief) such as morphine, fentanyl, pethidine
Medicines used to reduce blood cholesterol levels (such as cholestyramine, colestipol)
Corticosteroids (used to manage inflammation) Ex. prednisolone
Corticotropin (a medicine used to correct hormone problems)
Noradrenaline (a medicine used to increase blood pressure)
Tubocurarine, dantrolene (medicines used to relax muscles)
Medicines used for pain and inflammation (such as ibuprofen or indomethacin)
Lithium (a medicine used to manage metal illnesses)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while taking AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET as it may reduce your blood pressure abnormally and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more AMLOVIN H 2.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Overdosage may cause low blood pressure, abnormal heartbeat and dizziness.

S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET Works

S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.
usageDetails:
How to use S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET

Take S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET.
S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, headache, fatigue (extreme tiredness), impaired ability to react or nausea after taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET.
S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET.
S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET.
S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to dihydropyridine derivatives (such as felodipine, nimodipine), S-Amlodipine, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure), shock including cardiogenic shock (serious condition caused by the sudden drop in blood flow through the body, high grade aortic stenosis (obstruction of the outflow tract of the left ventricle), or haemodynamically unstable heart failure after heart attack. S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET
Safety and effectiveness of S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET is not established in children. Consult child’s doctor for advice.
S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage certain viral infections (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, miconazole)
Certain medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin, rifampicin)
Certain medicines used to lower blood pressure (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Dantrolene infusion (used to manage muscle stiffness)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection (Ex. tacrolimus, cyclosporine)
Simvastatin (used to reduce blood cholesterol)
St. john's wort (used to manage depression)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET as it may drop your blood pressure further. 

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of S AMCARD 2.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The common symptoms of overdose are low blood pressure and fast heartbeat.

name: DILTANOL 30 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DILTANOL 30 TABLET

DILTANOL 30 TABLET contains Diltiazem which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers. It is used to manage angina and hypertension. It also manages you from getting chest pain in future.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Angina pectoris is a type of chest pain caused due to an inadequate supply of oxygen to the heart muscle. Symptoms include severe chest pain, tightness or heaviness with dizziness, fatigue, sweating, shortness of breath and fast heart rate.

During management with DILTANOL 30 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from angina and hypertension. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, stomach problems or any form of mental illness as a precaution.

DILTANOL 30 TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. It is also not recommended for use in patients with heart failure, severe low blood pressure, problems in blood circulation or if you are a breastfeeding woman.

The most common side effects of taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET are nausea, indigestion, constipation, dizziness and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DILTANOL 30 TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage and manages angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How DILTANOL 30 TABLET Works

DILTANOL 30 TABLET is a calcium channel blocker. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use DILTANOL 30 TABLET

Take DILTANOL 30 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET without consulting your doctor.
sideEffects: Swelling of the fingers, ankles, feet (edema)
Feeling dizzy while standing up or changing posture
Signs of allergic reactions (such as skin rash, swelling of the face, lips, mouth or throat which can lead to difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Difficulty in breathing or worsening of asthma

Severe skin reactions (such as skin rash with itching and redness, blistering and peeling of skin, skin swelling and inflammation of mucous membrane, skin lesions with a pink/red ring and a pale center which may be itchy, scaly or filled with fluid)
Fast, slow or uneven heart rate
Signs of heart failure (such as shortness of breath with chest pain and swollen ankles)
Unusual body movements, facial muscle spasms, rolling eyes, feeling shaky
Signs of liver problems (fever, tiredness, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea)
Signs of high blood sugar levels (such as excessive thirst, passing more urine than normal and dryness of skin or mouth)

warnings.details: DILTANOL 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and in women who think that they might be pregnant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
DILTANOL 30 TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. However, consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or tiredness after taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
DILTANOL 30 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
DILTANOL 30 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take DILTANOL 30 TABLET if you are allergic to Diltiazem.
DILTANOL 30 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a previous history of asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DILTANOL 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious heart problems (such as having a very slow or uneven heartbeat or heart failure). It should be used with caution in patients with a previous history of heart failure, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or low blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

DILTANOL 30 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have problems in blood circulation especially to the lungs

Before taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have any surgery in the upcoming days
Have depression
Have any mental illness that causes mood changes
Have any stomach problems
Have diabetes
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Use in Pediatrics:

DILTANOL 30 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in Geriatrics:

DILTANOL 30 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Digoxin, amiodarone, ivabradine (medicines used to manage abnormal heart rhythm)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Lomitapide (a medicine used to control blood cholesterol levels)
Asunaprevir (a medicine used to manage Hepatitis C infection)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure (such as doxazosin, tamsulosin, atenolol, propranolol or acebutolol)
Medicines used to manage angina (such as glyceryl trinitrate or isosorbide trinitrate)
Medicines used to manage high blood cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin, fluvastatin and atorvastatin)
Ciclosporin (a medicine used to suppress the body's immune function)
Phenytoin, carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Medicines used to manage blood clots (Ex. aspirin, clopidogrel)
Iodinated contrast media (used during X-rays)
Theophylline (a medicine used to manage asthma) 
Lithium (a medicine used to manage mental problems)
Benzodiazepines (medicines used to manage anxiety) Ex. midazolam, triazolam
Methylprednisolone (a steroid medicine used to manage allergies and inflammation)
Cilostazol (a medicine used to manage leg cramps)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Cimetidine, ranitidine (medicines used for stomach ulcers)

B. Drug-Food Interactions:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking DILTANOL 30 TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more DILTANOL 30 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include severe hypotension (low blood pressure) leading to dizziness, fainting, slow heartbeat and changes in heart rhythm.

Introduction About C UDP 10MG TABLET

C UDP 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking C UDP 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

C UDP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking C UDP 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking C UDP 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How C UDP 10MG TABLET Works

C UDP 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLO CB 5MG TABLET

AMLO CB 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLO CB 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLO CB 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLO CB 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLO CB 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About BENIFLO 4MG TABLET

BENIFLO 4MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENIFLO 4MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENIFLO 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENIFLO 4MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENIFLO 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENIFLO 4MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About BENICARD 4 TABLET

BENICARD 4 TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENICARD 4 TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENICARD 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENICARD 4 TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENICARD 4 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BENICARD 4 TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

name: AMLOVAG 2.5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET

AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET Works

AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET

Like all medicines, AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET:
Swelling of ankles
Headache, dizziness
Sleepiness, tiredness, muscle cramps
Palpitations (awareness of heart beat)
Flushing
Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, indigestion
Nausea
Altered bowel habits
Visual disturbances, double vision
Vomiting
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET.
AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
AMLOVAG 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About CINATAB 10 TABLET

CINATAB 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CINATAB 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CINATAB 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CINATAB 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CINATAB 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

name: Natcocil CT Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NATCOCIL CT TABLET

NATCOCIL CT TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Cilnidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels. Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

NATCOCIL CT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease and it should be used in caution with patient having diabetes.

NATCOCIL CT TABLET is not intended for use in the pregnant and breast-feeding woman. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

As safety and efficacy in children has not been established, consult your doctor about the risk and benefits before taking NATCOCIL CT TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking NATCOCIL CT TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects are not improving.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NATCOCIL CT TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How NATCOCIL CT TABLET Works

NATCOCIL CT TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction.
usageDetails:
How to use NATCOCIL CT TABLET

Take NATCOCIL CT TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: UDP 5 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About UDP 5 TABLET

UDP 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take UDP 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking UDP 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of UDP 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking UDP 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of UDP 5 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How UDP 5 TABLET Works

UDP 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take UDP 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

warnings.details: The safety of UDP 5 TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
UDP 5 TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking UDP 5 TABLET.
UDP 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take UDP 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

UDP 5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
UDP 5 TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
UDP 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

name: MOLD AT Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MOLD AT TABLET

MOLD AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take MOLD AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking MOLD AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking MOLD AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

MOLD AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking MOLD AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking MOLD AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOLD AT TABLET

MOLD AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How MOLD AT TABLET Works

MOLD AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

Do not stop taking the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

MOLD AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

MOLD AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

introduction:
Introduction About CILMIKAA 10 TABLET

CILMIKAA 10 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILMIKAA 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILMIKAA 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILMIKAA 10 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILMIKAA 10 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILMIKAA 10 TABLET Works

CILMIKAA 10 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET

ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET

Manages,

Essential hypertension
Angina pectoris
mechanismOfAction:
How ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET Works

ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.
usageDetails:
How to use ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET

Take ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of ESPIN 1.25MG TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEDIPIN 5 TABLET

MEDIPIN 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take MEDIPIN 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking MEDIPIN 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of MEDIPIN 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking MEDIPIN 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEDIPIN 5 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How MEDIPIN 5 TABLET Works

MEDIPIN 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take MEDIPIN 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of MEDIPIN 5 TABLET

Like all medicines, MEDIPIN 5 TABLET may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of MEDIPIN 5 TABLET:
Swelling of ankles
Headache, dizziness
Sleepiness, tiredness, muscle cramps
Palpitations (awareness of heart beat)
Flushing
Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, indigestion
Nausea
Altered bowel habits
Visual disturbances, double vision
Vomiting
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of MEDIPIN 5 TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
MEDIPIN 5 TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking MEDIPIN 5 TABLET.
MEDIPIN 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take MEDIPIN 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

MEDIPIN 5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
MEDIPIN 5 TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
MEDIPIN 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

name: CUPINE AT Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CUPINE AT TABLET

CUPINE AT TABLET is used to manage hypertension and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

It contains a combination of Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents.

Take CUPINE AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking CUPINE AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking CUPINE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

CUPINE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking CUPINE AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CUPINE AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CUPINE AT TABLET

CUPINE AT TABLET is used in the management of the following cardiac conditions:

Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How CUPINE AT TABLET Works

CUPINE AT TABLET contains two medicines namely amlodipine and atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.

warnings.details: CUPINE AT TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CUPINE AT TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk to the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking CUPINE AT TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CUPINE AT TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
CUPINE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CUPINE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CUPINE AT TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
CUPINE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CUPINE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CUPINE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
CUPINE AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CUPINE AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking CUPINE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CUPINE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure and angina (such as nifedipine, verapamil, diltiazem, enalapril, ramipril, metoprolol, clonidine)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection and to suppress immune functions (such as tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everlimus, cyclosporine)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat (Ex. amiodarone, digoxin, quinidine or disopyramide)
Adrenaline (a medicine used to stimulate the heart)
Indomethacin or ibuprofen (medicines used for pain relief)
Medicines used to manage nose or sinus congestion and other cold remedies (such as montelukast, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. insulin, metformin, glimepiride)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking CUPINE AT TABLET, as it could lead to further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more CUPINE AT TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin and shortness of breath.

name: VITABEND 8mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About VITABEND 8MG TABLET

VITABEND 8MG TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

VITABEND 8MG TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking VITABEND 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking VITABEND 8MG TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking VITABEND 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking VITABEND 8MG TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages chest pain associated with angina pectoris
usesDetails:

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)

mechanismOfAction:
How VITABEND 8MG TABLET Works

VITABEND 8MG TABLET reduces blood pressure and chest pain, where benidipine acts by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. As a result, it improves blood flow to the heart which therefore reduces the pressure on the heart, thus making it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

Take VITABEND 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take VITABEND 8MG TABLET preferably after meals. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VITABEND 8MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

RUXLO 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take RUXLO 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking RUXLO 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of RUXLO 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking RUXLO 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.

How RUXLO 5 TABLET Works

RUXLO 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
