Side Effects Of RUXLO 5 TABLET

Like all medicines, RUXLO 5 TABLET may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of RUXLO 5 TABLET:
Swelling of ankles
Headache, dizziness
Sleepiness, tiredness, muscle cramps
Palpitations (awareness of heart beat)
Flushing
Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, indigestion
Nausea
Altered bowel habits
Visual disturbances, double vision
Vomiting
Joint or muscle pain, back pain
When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of RUXLO 5 TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
RUXLO 5 TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking RUXLO 5 TABLET.
RUXLO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take RUXLO 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

RUXLO 5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
RUXLO 5 TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
RUXLO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIX 10MG TABLET

CILNIX 10MG TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CILNIX 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CILNIX 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CILNIX 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIX 10MG TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIX 10MG TABLET Works

CILNIX 10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Take the tablet with a glass of water, and do not crush, chew, or break it.
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.
Always consult your healthcare provider for specific instructions based on your health condition.

name: Amwel AT Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMWEL AT TABLET

AMWEL AT TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

Take AMWEL AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMWEL AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking AMWEL AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

AMWEL AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking AMWEL AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AMWEL AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMWEL AT TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage angina (chest pain)
Prevents heart attack
mechanismOfAction:
How AMWEL AT TABLET Works

AMWEL AT TABLET contains two medicines namely S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use AMWEL AT TABLET

Take AMWEL AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. AMWEL AT TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take AMWEL AT TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Others

AMWEL AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking AMWEL AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

Use in pediatrics:

AMWEL AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

AMWEL AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET

ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET Works

ALBIPIN 5MG TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.

The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.

introduction:
Introduction About NEPIN SR 20MG TABLET

NEPIN SR 20MG TABLET contains Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high and is characterised by headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, a feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. Angina is a type of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart and characterised by a squeezing type of pain, pressure, heaviness, and tightness in the chest.

NEPIN SR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver and heart disease and should be used with caution with patients having kidney dialysis, improper liver function, or poor cardiac reserve. It should be used with caution in pregnant women, and it is not recommended in a breast-feeding woman; consult your doctor for advice.

NEPIN SR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking NEPIN SR 20MG TABLET are headache, flushing, a general feeling of being unwell, constipation, and swelling, particularly of the ankles and legs. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
usesDetails:

Manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (chest pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NEPIN SR 20MG TABLET Works

NEPIN SR 20MG TABLET reduces blood pressure by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels for easy blood flow and thereby lowers the blood pressure, which reduces the strain on the heart. It also works by relaxing and expanding the blood vessels supplying the heart, which allows more blood and oxygen to reach the heart and decreases the strain on it. This reduces the severity and frequency of angina attacks.

introduction:
Introduction About CABLOK 10 TABLET

CABLOK 10 TABLET contains Cilnidipine, a calcium channel blocker used for managing high blood pressure (hypertension). It helps relax blood vessels, ensuring better blood flow and reducing the heart's workload.

Take CABLOK 10 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water, preferably at the same time each day. Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet.

How CABLOK 10 TABLET helps improve quality of life?

CABLOK 10 TABLET is a calcium channel blocker (CCB) that relaxes and widens blood vessels by inhibiting calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells. This leads to reduced blood pressure, which helps in reducing complications like heart attacks, strokes, and kidney damage.

With better physical health, reduced stress, and greater energy, patients experience a significant improvement in overall quality of life, including emotional and social aspects.

The common side effects of CABLOK 10 TABLET include dizziness, headache, and flushing. If you experience severe side effects, consult your doctor immediately.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CABLOK 10 TABLET
High blood pressure (Hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How CABLOK 10 TABLET Works

CABLOK 10 TABLET contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator, blocks the channels, reducing calcium ions from entering the cells. This results in:

Relaxation of vascular smooth muscles
Dilation of blood vessels (vasodilation)
Reduction in vascular resistance, which leads to a decrease in blood pressure
As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure
It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart function and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke

Always take this medicine as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily
Swallow the CABLOK 10 TABLET whole with water, preferably at the same time each day
Cilnidipine can be taken with or without food, but taking it at the same time every day helps maintain steady blood levels
Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure

sideEffects: L-Type Calcium Channels: It is found in the smooth muscle of blood vessels, by blocking these channels causes relaxation and dilation of blood vessels, reducing vascular resistance and lowering blood pressure

N-Type Calcium Channels: It is located in the sympathetic nerves that control stress responses. Also inhibits and reduces the release of norepinephrine, a neurotransmitter responsible for constricting blood vessels during stress. This helps in controlling stress-induced spikes in blood pressure
CABLOK 10 TABLET is a calcium channel blocker (CCB) that relaxes and widens blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessel walls
This action reduces vascular resistance and lowers blood pressure, which is a primary risk factor for heart attacks and strokes
By reducing vascular resistance, CABLOK 10 TABLET decreases the effort required for the heart to pump blood, improving heart efficiency and reducing the risk of heart attacks
Uncontrolled hypertension is a major risk factor for heart attacks and strokes. CABLOK 10 TABLET helps to maintain stable blood pressure, reducing the likelihood of these life-threatening events
It also protects the brain and heart by reducing sudden pressure spikes that can lead to vascular rupture or clots

warnings.details: CABLOK 10 TABLET (Cilnidipine) is classified as a Category C medication for pregnancy, indicating that its safety in pregnant women has not been established. It should only be used during pregnancy if the potential benefit outweighs the risk.

There is no sufficient data on the excretion of CABLOK 10 TABLET (Cilnidipine) in breast milk, and due to potential risks to the infant, it is advised to avoid its use while breastfeeding or consult a healthcare provider for safer alternatives.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking CABLOK 10 TABLET
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CABLOK 10 TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.

CABLOK 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Dosage adjustment and careful monitoring are required in such patients. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing kidney diseases as a precaution.

CABLOK 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Regular medical check-ups and blood tests are required in such patients. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver diseases as a precaution.
Do not take CABLOK 10 TABLET if you are allergic to Cilnidipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

CABLOK 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure or aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries). It should be used with caution in patients with angina or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Safety and efficacy of CABLOK 10 TABLET in paediatric patients has not been established. Thus, it are not recommended in children.
CABLOK 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About BENEDINOL 8 TABLET

BENEDINOL 8 TABLET contains Benidipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several organs such as heart, kidney, or brain, thus causing heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, stroke, or even blindness.

BENEDINOL 8 TABLET can also be used to manage renal parenchymal hypertension (high blood pressure in the kidneys caused due to kidney problems) and angina pectoris. Angina pectoris is a sudden, sharp, and severe chest pain that originates from the apex of the heart and radiates to the left shoulder. It can be characterized by the presence of severe and crushing pain along with a feeling of pressure and suffocation, especially behind the breastbone.

Benidipine works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart. It improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces pressure on the heart and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body. It also exerts protective effects on the kidney cells by reducing the blood pressure within the kidneys.

Before taking BENEDINOL 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or heart problems (such as severe low blood pressure or cardiac shock). Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking BENEDINOL 8 TABLET as it may further decrease your blood pressure. Before taking BENEDINOL 8 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. The most common side effects of taking BENEDINOL 8 TABLET are rapid heartbeat, headache, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

It also improves oxygen supply to the heart, which therefore reduces ischemic symptoms (such as chest pain and heaviness) associated with angina. Benidipine can also relax the blood vessels supplying the kidneys which therefore reduces pressure within the kidneys and manages further kidney damage.

S CUPINE 2.5 TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. S CUPINE 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. S CUPINE 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. S CUPINE 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

S CUPINE 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking S CUPINE 2.5 TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET

S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol which belongs to the group of medicine called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) and angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to lack of oxygen supply to the heart). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) among heart patients.

Take S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, as it could further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

Before taking S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, overactive thyroid gland or low blood volume as a precaution.

S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems apart from hypertension and angina (such as heart failure). It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Consult your doctor before taking S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, muscle cramps, cold hands and feet and slow heartbeat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage angina (chest pain)
Prevents heart attack
mechanismOfAction:
How S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET Works

S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET contains two medicines namely S(-)Amlodipine and Atenolol. Atenolol blocks the effects of certain hormones (adrenaline) in the body that naturally increases heart rate. This slows down the heartbeat and makes the heart to pump blood with a lesser force.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET

Take S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET can be taken with or without meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier.
S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET if you are allergic to Atenolol, S(-)Amlodipine or to any other beta blockers (such as propranolol) or calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem).
S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have or previously had any breathing problems such as asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of heart attack or heart failure in the recent days. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have a very poor blood circulation
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (a tumor present in the adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (high acid levels in the blood)

Before taking S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have low blood volume (loss of fluids from the body due to vomiting or diarrhea)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased activity of the thyroid gland)
Have psoriasis (an autoimmune skin condition causing white patches)
Any scheduled for any operations or procedures

Use in pediatrics:

S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

S AMLOSAFE AT TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection and to suppress immune functions (such as tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everlimus, cyclosporine)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat (Ex. amiodarone, digoxin, quinidine or disopyramide)

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOSSIL AT TABLET, as it could lead to further decrease your blood pressure and may make you feel dizzier, drowsier or faint.

If you or anyone else accidentally took more AMLOSSIL AT TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin and shortness of breath.

introduction:
Introduction About CUPINE 5 TABLET

CUPINE 5 TABLET is a medication used primarily for the management of high blood pressure (hypertension) and angina (Prinzmetal’s or variant angina). The active ingredient, Amlodipine , is a calcium channel blocker that helps relax blood vessels, reducing strain on the heart and lowering blood pressure and chest pain.

You can take CUPINE 5 TABLET at any time of the day, with or without food. For the best results, try to take it around the same time every day. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and take the medication for as long as prescribed, even if you feel fine. Sudden discontinuation may worsen your condition, as high blood pressure often has no visible symptoms.

Complement your therapy with regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and weight management to maintain optimal blood pressure levels.

Before taking CUPINE 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, as this may affect your dosage. If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before using this medicine. Always share details about any other medications you are taking, especially those for blood pressure or heart conditions, as interactions could affect the efficacy of CUPINE 5 TABLET.

Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential to ensure the medication is working as intended and to adjust the dosage if needed. The most common side effects of taking CUPINE 5 TABLET are headache, edema (swelling), fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, and drowsiness. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CUPINE 5 TABLET
High blood pressure (hypertension)
Angina (prinzmetal’s or variant angina)
mechanismOfAction:
How CUPINE 5 TABLET Works

CUPINE 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take CUPINE 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

When to consult your doctor?

Stop taking the medicine, and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Sudden wheeziness, chest pain, shortness of breath or difficulty in breathing
Swelling of the tongue and throat which causes great difficulty breathing
Severe skin reactions including an intense skin rash, hives, reddening of the skin over your whole body, severe itching, blistering, peeling and swelling of the skin, inflammation of mucous membranes (stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) or other allergic reactions

warnings.details: The safety of CUPINE 5 TABLET in human pregnancy has not been established. If you think you might be pregnant, or are planning to get pregnant, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
CUPINE 5 TABLET has been shown to pass into breast milk in small amounts. If you are breast-feeding or about to start breast-feeding, consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience sickness, dizziness or tiredness or headache after taking CUPINE 5 TABLET.
CUPINE 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take CUPINE 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

CUPINE 5 TABLET is not recommended if you have narrowing of the aortic heart valve (aortic stenosis) or cardiogenic shock or suffer from heart failure after a heart attack. It should be used with caution if you have recent heart attack or heart failure, severe increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis).
CUPINE 5 TABLET has not been studied in children under the age of 6 years. It should only be used for hypertension in children and adolescents from 6 years to 17 years of age.
CUPINE 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Dosage will be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About CLIBIT 20 TABLET

CLIBIT 20 TABLET is used for the management of hypertension and its associated vascular disorders. It can also be used for dealing with hypertension for end organ protection.

It contains Cilnidipine which is a vasodilator that relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other major organs. This action reduces the strain on the heart and makes your heart pump blood efficiently, which therefore helps in reduces blood pressure and problems associated with blood circulation.

Before taking CLIBIT 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), edema or congestive heart failure.

CLIBIT 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves. Consult your doctor before taking CLIBIT 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CLIBIT 20 TABLET are swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, dizziness, flushing, skin rashes and gingival hyperplasia (enlargement or overgrowth of the gums). Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLIBIT 20 TABLET
Hypertension and its associated vascular disorders
Hypertension for end organ protection
mechanismOfAction:
How CLIBIT 20 TABLET Works

CLIBIT 20 TABLET is a vasodilator. It works by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within the blood vessels that causes narrowing. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent control of your blood pressure.

How AMLOSSIL 5 TABLET Works

AMLOSSIL 5 TABLET contains Amlodipine. In patients with high blood pressure it works by relaxing blood vessels, so that blood passes through them more easily. In patients with angina it works by improving blood supply to the heart muscle which then receives more oxygen and as a result chest pain is managed. This medicine does not provide immediate relief of chest pain from angina.
usageInstructions: Take AMLOSSIL 5 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken once a day, with or without food. For best results, try to take it at the same time each day.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The typical starting dose of Amlodipine is 5mg per day. Depending on your condition and response to the medication, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Always follow your doctor's instructions regarding the dose and duration of treatment for optimal results in managing cholesterol levels and cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About S CUPINE 5 TABLET

S CUPINE 5 TABLET contains S-Amlodipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension (abnormal high blood pressure which occurs mostly due to obesity, family history or unhealthy diet) and angina pectoris (type of chest pain due to reduced blood flow to the heart).  

S CUPINE 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with certain heart problems. S CUPINE 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver and kidney impairment. S CUPINE 5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor.  

S CUPINE 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients so, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking S CUPINE 5 TABLET are headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, indigestion and visual disturbances, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How S CUPINE 5 TABLET Works

S CUPINE 5 TABLET reduces blood pressure by a direct relaxant effect on smooth muscle of blood vessels. In angina, it works by reducing the pressure against which the heart works, stabilizing the heart rate and thus reducing energy consumption and oxygen requirements by the heart muscle. It also probably dilatates the main coronary arteries and increases oxygen delivery by heart muscle in patients with coronary artery spasm.

Take S CUPINE 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Correct dosage and duration of S CUPINE 5 TABLET will be prescribed to you by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking S CUPINE 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage certain viral infections (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, miconazole)
Certain medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin, rifampicin)
Certain medicines used to lower blood pressure (Ex. verapamil, diltiazem)
Dantrolene infusion (used to manage muscle stiffness)
Medicines used to manage graft rejection (Ex. tacrolimus, cyclosporine)
Simvastatin (used to reduce blood cholesterol)
St. john's wort (used to manage depression)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking S CUPINE 5 TABLET as it may drop your blood pressure further. 

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of S CUPINE 5 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The common symptoms of overdose are low blood pressure and fast heartbeat.
